title.zh: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七 高宗四
title.raw: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七 高宗四 Volume 27 Annals 27: Gaozong 4

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，楊華復叛，擾鼎、澧、潭三州。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi: Yang Hua rebelled again and harassed Ding, Li, and Tan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiazi: Yang Hua rose again and ravaged Ding, Li, and Tan.

sentences.zh: 詔立賞禽捕首領，赦貸脅從。

translations.literal: An edict set rewards for capturing leaders and pardoned those coerced to follow.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered bounty for ringleaders and pardoned the pressed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命劉光世將銳卒萬人屯揚州，經理淮東。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Liu Guangshi was ordered to lead ten thousand picked troops to garrison Yangzhou and manage Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Liu Guangshi was told to camp ten thousand elite at Yangzhou and settle Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以李綱為觀文殿學士、湖廣宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Li Gang was made Guanwen Hall academician and Huguang pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Gang became Guanwen academician and Huguang pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 仍命岳飛率馬友、李宏、韓京、吳錫等共討曹成諸盜。

translations.literal: He was further ordered that Yue Fei with Ma You, Li Hong, Han Jing, Wu Xi, and others jointly suppress Cao Cheng and the other bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei was further ordered, with Ma You, Li Hong, Han Jing, Wu Xi, and others, to crush Cao Cheng and the rest.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以吏部尚書李光為淮西招撫使，王𤫉副之。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Personnel Minister Li Guang was made Huai west soothing commissioner; Wang Fu was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Personnel Minister Li Guang was made Huai west soothing commissioner, with Wang Fu as deputy.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day yihai: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以施逵、謝向、陸棠党範汝為，逵除名、婺州編管，向、棠械赴行在，俱道死。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Shi Kui, Xie Xiang, and Lu Tang were convicted as Fan Ruwei's faction; Kui was stripped of name and assigned to Wuzhou registry control, Xiang and Tang were shackled to the mobile court, and all died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Shi Kui, Xie Xiang, and Lu Tang were judged Fan Ruwei's party; Kui was struck from the rolls and sent to Wuzhou registry control, Xiang and Tang were chained toward court, and all died on the road.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，分崔增、李捧、邵青、趙延壽、李振、單德忠、徐文所部兵為七將，名御前忠銳軍，隸步軍司，非樞密奉旨，不許調遣。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the troops of Cui Zeng, Li Peng, Shao Qing, Zhao Yanshou, Li Zhen, Shan Dezhong, and Xu Wen were divided into seven commands, named the Imperial Loyal Sharp Army, subordinate to the Infantry Bureau; without a Privy Council edict they might not be transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the divisions of Cui Zeng, Li Peng, Shao Qing, Zhao Yanshou, Li Zhen, Shan Dezhong, and Xu Wen were split into seven commands as the Imperial Loyal Sharp Army under the Infantry Bureau, not to move without Privy Council order.

sentences.zh: 減淮南營田歲租三之二，俟三年復舊。

translations.literal: Huainan garrison-farm annual rent was reduced by two-thirds, to be restored after three years.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan garrison-farm rent was cut by two-thirds for three years, then restored.

sentences.zh: 己卯，劉光世入見，同執政對內殿，諭以進屯揚州，光世迄不行。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Liu Guangshi had audience; with chief ministers he was admonished in the inner hall to advance and camp at Yangzhou; Guangshi never went.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Liu Guangshi was received; with the chief ministers he was told in the inner hall to advance to Yangzhou, but Guangshi never marched.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔監司避本貫。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered surveillance commissioners to avoid their native circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, surveillance commissioners were ordered to avoid their home circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬午，程昌寓遣杜湛募兵攻賊周倫，破之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan to raise troops and attack the bandit Zhou Lun; he broke him.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan to levy troops against Zhou Lun and broke him.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以工部員外郎滕茂實死節於代州，贈龍圖閣直學士。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Works Ministry outer-office member Teng Maoshi, who died loyal at Dai prefecture, was posthumously made Dragon Diagram Hall direct academician.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Teng Maoshi of the Works Ministry, who died loyal at Dai, was posthumously made Dragon Diagram direct academician.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，初置著作官二員修《日曆》。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: two compilation officers were first established to compile the Daily Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, two compilation officers were first set to compile the Daily Calendar.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復荊湖東、西為荊湖南、北路，南路治潭，北路仍治鄂。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Jing-Hu east and west were restored as Jing-Hu south and north routes; the south route was seated at Tan, the north still at E.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Jing-Hu east and west were restored to south and north routes; south sat at Tan, north still at E.

sentences.zh: 申禁福建路私有、私造兵器。

translations.literal: An edict forbade private possession and private manufacture of weapons on the Fujian circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was forbidden private arms and private forging.

sentences.zh: 是月，知商州董先叛入劉豫。

translations.literal: That month, Shang prefecture magistrate Dong Xian rebelled and entered Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Dong Xian of Shang rebelled and went over to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 金人陷慶陽府，執楊可升，降之。

translations.literal: Jin took Qingyang prefecture, seized Yang Kesheng, and he surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Qingyang, seized Yang Kesheng, and he bowed.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，命襄、鄧鎮撫使桑仲收復陷沒諸郡，仍命諸鎮撫使互相應援。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen new moon: Xiang-Deng pacification commissioner Sang Zhong was ordered to recover lost prefectures and all pacification commissioners were to support one another.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renchen new moon: Sang Zhong of Xiang-Deng was ordered to retake lost prefectures; all pacification commissioners were to aid one another.

sentences.zh: 再貶徐秉哲惠州，吳開南雄州，莫儔韶州，並居住。

translations.literal: Xu Bingzhe was demoted again to Huizhou, Wu Kai to Nanxiong, and Mo Chou to Shaozhou, all to reside there.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Bingzhe was demoted again to Huizhou, Wu Kai to Nanxiong, Mo Chou to Shaozhou, all to reside.

sentences.zh: 水賊翟進襲漢陽軍，殺守臣趙令戣。

translations.literal: River bandit Zhai Jin raided Hanyang army, killing defender Zhao Linggui.
translations.idiomatic: River bandit Zhai Jin struck Hanyang army and killed defender Zhao Linggui.

sentences.zh: 李光執韓世清于宣州以歸。

translations.literal: Li Guang seized Han Shiqing at Xuan prefecture and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guang seized Han Shiqing at Xuan and brought him in.

sentences.zh: 虔化縣賊李敦仁及其徒皆授官，隸諸軍。

translations.literal: Ganhuaxian bandit Li Dunren and his followers were all given office and assigned to various armies.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dunren of Ganhuaxian and his band were all given rank and folded into the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復置江陰軍。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Jiangyin army was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jiangyin army was restored.

sentences.zh: 罷福建路武尉。

translations.literal: Fujian circuit military commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian military commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，葉夢得罷。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Ye Mengde was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Ye Mengde was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以李光為江東安撫大使，兼滁、濠等六州宣撫使。

translations.literal: Li Guang was made Jiangdong grand soothing commissioner and concurrently pacification commissioner for six prefectures including Chuzhou and Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guang became Jiangdong grand soothing commissioner and also pacification commissioner for Chuzhou, Haozhou, and four other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 罷江、淮發運司。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai transport office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai transport office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 桑仲如郢州調兵，守將霍明以仲將謀逆，殺之，以其事聞。

translations.literal: Sang Zhong went to Ying prefecture to levy troops; defender Huo Ming thought Zhong meant treason and killed him, then reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Zhong went to Ying to levy troops; defender Huo Ming thought him traitor, killed him, and reported up.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金人攻方山原，陝西統制楊政援之，金兵引去。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Jin attacked Fangshan plain; Shaanxi controller Yang Zheng reinforced and the Jin withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Jin hit Fangshan plain; Yang Zheng of Shaanxi reinforced and they drew off.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，又犯隴安縣，吳璘等擊走之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: they struck Long'an county again; Wu Lin and others beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, they struck Long'an again; Wu Lin and others drove them off.

sentences.zh: 淮南營田副使王寔括閒田三萬頃給六軍耕種。

translations.literal: Huainan garrison-farm deputy commissioner Wang Shi surveyed thirty thousand qing of idle land for the six armies to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan garrison-farm deputy Wang Shi surveyed thirty thousand qing of idle land for the six armies to till.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復置中書門下省檢正官，省樞密院檢詳官。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Secretariat and Chancellery inspection officers were restored, and Privy Council review officers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Secretariat inspection officers were restored, and Privy Council review officers.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以神武右軍中部統制楊沂中為神武中軍統制。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Shenwu Right Army middle controller Yang Yizhong was made Shenwu Central Army controller.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yang Yizhong, middle controller of Shenwu Right, became Shenwu Central controller.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，河南鎮撫使翟興為部將楊偉所殺。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Henan pacification commissioner Zhai Xing was killed by his officer Yang Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Henan pacification commissioner Zhai Xing was killed by his officer Yang Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，金人復自水洛城來攻，楊政等又敗之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Jin came again from Shuiluo city to attack; Yang Zheng and others defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Jin came again from Shuiluo; Yang Zheng and others beat them again.

sentences.zh: 庚申，曹成寇賀州清水砦，守臣劉全棄城去。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Cao Cheng raided Qingshui stockade at He prefecture; defender Liu Quan abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cao Cheng hit Qingshui stockade at He; Liu Quan abandoned the walls.

sentences.zh: 是月，知壽春府陳卞及鈐轄陳寶等舉兵復順昌府，尋引兵歸，為偽齊所逐，並壽春失之。

translations.literal: That month, Shouchun prefecture magistrate Chen Bi and controller Chen Bao and others raised troops and retook Shunchang, then withdrew; the puppet Qi drove them off and Shouchun was lost.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chen Bi of Shouchun and controller Chen Bao retook Shunchang, then withdrew; puppet Qi drove them off and Shouchun fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，曹成陷賀州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiazi: Cao Cheng took He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiazi: Cao Cheng took He.

sentences.zh: 陳顒圍循州，焚龍川縣，命江西安撫司遣將捕之。

translations.literal: Chen Yong besieged Xun prefecture and burned Longchuan county; Jiangxi pacification office was ordered to send officers to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yong besieged Xun and burned Longchuan; Jiangxi pacification was told to send officers after him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜禮部進士張九成以下二百五十九人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Ministry of Rites advanced scholars Zhang Jiucheng and two hundred fifty-nine others were given jinshi and origin degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhang Jiucheng and two hundred fifty-nine Ministry of Rites graduates received jinshi and origin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以翰林學士承旨翟汝文參知政事。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Hanlin academician and chief drafter Zhai Ruwen was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hanlin chief drafter Zhai Ruwen became Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，釋福建諸州雜犯死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Day renshen: miscellaneous capital and lesser prisoners of Fujian circuits were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fujian's miscellaneous capital and lesser prisoners were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 江西軍賊趙進寇瑞昌縣，楊惟忠討降之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi army bandit Zhao Jin raided Ruichang county; Yang Weizhong suppressed and induced surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi bandit Zhao Jin hit Ruichang; Yang Weizhong broke him and took surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，偽齊統領王資率兵來歸。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: puppet Qi commander Wang Zi led troops to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, puppet Qi commander Wang Zi came over with his troops.

sentences.zh: 富順監男子李勃偽稱徐王，召赴行在。

translations.literal: Fushun supervisor's son Li Bo falsely claimed to be Prince Xu and was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bo, son of a Fushun supervisor, falsely claimed the Prince Xu and was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔內外侍從、監司、守臣各舉中原流寓士大夫三二人，以備任使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered inner and outer attendants, surveillance commissioners, and prefectural defenders each to recommend two or three exiled Central Plain scholars for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, inner and outer attendants, surveillance commissioners, and defenders were each to name two or three exiled Central Plain scholars for service.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔曰：「朕登庸二相，倚遇惟均。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict said: "We have raised two chancellors and rely on them equally.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict said: "We have raised two chancellors and lean on them alike.

sentences.zh: 其所薦用之人，不得偏私離間，朋比害政。

translations.literal: Those they recommend must not be favored with partiality to sow division, faction, and harm to government."
translations.idiomatic: Those they recommend must not be played off in faction to harm the state."

sentences.zh: 」諡孫傅曰忠定。

translations.literal: Sun Fu was given the posthumous title Zhongding.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fu was posthumously titled Zhongding.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，李綱始拜命，置司福州。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Li Gang first received commission and established headquarters at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Li Gang first took commission and set headquarters at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 是夜，太平州軍士陸德據城叛，囚守臣張錞，殺當塗縣令鐘大猷。

translations.literal: That night, Taiping prefecture soldiers under Lu De seized the city in revolt, imprisoned defender Zhang Kun, and killed Dangtu magistrate Zhong Dayou.
translations.idiomatic: That night Lu De's Taiping garrison seized the city, imprisoned defender Zhang Kun, and killed Dangtu magistrate Zhong Dayou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命呂頤浩都督江、淮、荊、浙諸軍事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Lü Yihao was made overall commander of Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Lü Yihao was made overall commander of Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，劉豫徙居汴京。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Liu Yu moved his residence to Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Yu moved his seat to Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 是月，王彥大破董先于馬嶺關，復商州。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Yan greatly defeated Dong Xian at Maling pass and recovered Shang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Yan shattered Dong Xian at Maling pass and retook Shang.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳，高麗遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guisi: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guisi: Goryeo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙未，知池州王進討陸德，誅之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Chizhou magistrate Wang Jin attacked Lu De and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Chizhou magistrate Wang Jin struck Lu De and executed him.

sentences.zh: 丙申，岳飛擊破曹成于賀州。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Yue Fei broke Cao Cheng at He prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Yue Fei broke Cao Cheng at He.

sentences.zh: 置都督府隨軍轉運司。

translations.literal: A mobile transport office for the overall command was established.
translations.idiomatic: A transport office for the overall command was set up.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，左朝奉郎孫覿坐前知臨安府贓汙，貸死除名、象州羈管。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Left Court Gentleman Sun Jue, for prior corruption as Lin'an magistrate, was spared death, stripped of name, and assigned to Xiangzhou registry control.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Sun Jue, for corruption as Lin'an magistrate, was spared death, struck from the rolls, and sent to Xiangzhou registry control.

sentences.zh: 罷後苑工作。

translations.literal: Rear-garden construction works were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Rear-garden construction was halted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，韓世清以狂悖伏誅。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Han Shiqing was executed for insolence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Han Shiqing was executed for insolence.

sentences.zh: 丙午，岳飛敗曹成于桂嶺縣，成走連州，遣統制張憲追擊，破之，又走郴州，入邵州。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Yue Fei defeated Cao Cheng at Guiling county; Cheng fled to Lian prefecture; controller Zhang Xian pursued, broke him, and he fled again to Chen prefecture and entered Shao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yue Fei beat Cao Cheng at Guiling; Cheng fled to Lian; Zhang Xian pursued and broke him; he fled to Chen and into Shao.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賜福建宣撫司賞軍錢十萬緡。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Fujian pacification office was granted one hundred thousand strings in reward money.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Fujian pacification was granted one hundred thousand strings in reward money.

sentences.zh: 聽朱勝非自便。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei was allowed to retire at will.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei was allowed to retire at will.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸鎮撫使非奉朝旨，毋擅出兵。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered pacification commissioners not to deploy troops without court order.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, pacification commissioners were forbidden to march without court order.

sentences.zh: 劉光世聞父喪去官，特命起復。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi heard of his father's death and left office; he was specially ordered to resume mourning service.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi left office on his father's death but was specially ordered back to duty.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔自今明堂專祀昊天上帝，乙太宗配。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict ordered that from now the Bright Hall would worship only the Supreme God of Heaven, with Taizong as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Bright Hall was ordered to worship only Heaven, with Taizong as associate.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚命利、夔制置使王庶與知成都府王似兩易其職。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Jun ordered Li and Kui commissioner Wang Shu and Chengdu magistrate Wang Si to exchange posts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun had Li-Kui commissioner Wang Shu and Chengdu magistrate Wang Si exchange posts.

sentences.zh: 襄、鄧副都統制李橫、同副都統制李道合兵圍郢州，霍明遁去。

translations.literal: Xiang-Deng deputy overall controller Li Heng and co-deputy Li Dao combined forces to besiege Ying prefecture; Huo Ming fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang-Deng deputy overall Li Heng and co-deputy Li Dao besieged Ying; Huo Ming fled.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，以兵部尚書權邦彥簽書樞密院事，以樞密將領趙琦所部兵為忠銳第八將。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: War Minister Quan Bangyan was made Privy Council signing officer; Privy Council officer Zhao Qi's troops were made the eighth Loyal Sharp command.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou: War Minister Quan Bangyan signed the Privy Council; Zhao Qi's troops became the eighth Loyal Sharp command.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，呂頤浩出師，以神武后軍及忠銳兩將從行，百官班送。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Lü Yihao took the field; Shenwu Rear Army and two Loyal Sharp commands followed; the hundred officials lined up to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Lü Yihao marched; Shenwu Rear and two Loyal Sharp commands followed; the hundred officials lined the send-off.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以霍明權襄、鄧、隨、郢州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Huo Ming was made acting Xiang-Deng-Sui-Ying pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Huo Ming was made acting Xiang-Deng-Sui-Ying pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔觀察使已上各薦可備將帥者二人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered observation commissioners and above each to recommend two men fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: Observation commissioners and above were each to name two men fit for command.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，罷兩浙轉運司回易庫。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the two-Zhe transport office exchange treasury was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the two-Zhe transport exchange treasury was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，廢紹興府余姚、上虞縣湖田為湖，溉民田。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Yuyao and Shangyu lake-fields in Shaoxing prefecture were restored to lake to irrigate civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yuyao and Shangyu lake-fields at Shaoxing were restored to lake to water civilian fields.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔修建康行宮。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict ordered construction of the Jiankang traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, construction of the Jiankang traveling palace was ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，選宗室子偁之子伯琮育于禁中。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an imperial clansman's son, the son of Zi, was raised in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an imperial clansman's son, son of Zi, was raised in the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，呂頤浩總師至常州，前軍將趙延壽兵叛于呂城鎮。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Lü Yihao's main force reached Changzhou; vanguard officer Zhao Yanshou's troops mutinied at Lücheng town.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lü Yihao reached Changzhou; vanguard Zhao Yanshou's men mutinied at Lücheng.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，延壽犯金壇縣，殺知縣胡思忠。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Yanshou raided Jin tan county and killed magistrate Hu Sizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Yanshou hit Jin tan and killed magistrate Hu Sizhong.

sentences.zh: 頤浩稱疾不進。

translations.literal: Yihao claimed illness and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yihao claimed illness and would not advance.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，海州賊王山犯漣水軍，總領蘇復、副統制劉靖會兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Haizhou bandit Wang Shan raided Lianshui army; overall controller Su Fu and deputy controller Liu Jing combined forces and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Haizhou bandit Wang Shan hit Lianshui; Su Fu and Liu Jing combined and beat him back.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，臨安府火。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lin'an burned.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置御前軍器所。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the Imperial Ordnance Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Imperial Ordnance Office was established.

sentences.zh: 甲申，親慮囚，自是歲如之。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor personally reviewed prisoners; thereafter this was done yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the emperor reviewed prisoners in person; thereafter yearly.

sentences.zh: 罷行在權官。

translations.literal: Acting officials at the mobile court were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Acting posts at the mobile court were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，劉光世遣王德追趙延壽叛兵至建平縣，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Liu Guangshi sent Wang De to pursue Zhao Yanshou's mutineers to Jianping county and executed them all.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Liu Guangshi sent Wang De after Zhao Yanshou's mutineers to Jianping and executed them all.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置修政局，命秦檜提舉。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Rehabilitation Bureau was established; Qin Hui was made its supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Rehabilitation Bureau was set up under Qin Hui.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、台省寺監官、監司、守令條具省費裕國強兵息民之策。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants, censorate and ministry officials, surveillance commissioners, and magistrates each to submit plans to save expenses, enrich the state, strengthen the army, and ease the people.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants, censorate and ministry men, surveillance commissioners, and magistrates were told to submit plans to save, enrich, strengthen, and ease.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以中書門下省檢正官仇悆為沿海制置使。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Secretariat inspection officer Qiu Yu was made coastal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Secretariat inspector Qiu Yu became coastal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，手詔用建隆故事，命百官日輪一人轉對。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: by hand-edict the Jianlong precedent was used; each day one hundred officials in rotation would address the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, by hand-edict the Jianlong rotation was restored: one official a day would address the throne.

sentences.zh: 兩浙轉運副使徐康國獻銷金屏障，詔有司毀之，奪康國二官。

translations.literal: Two-Zhe transport vice commissioner Xu Kangguo presented a gold-inlaid screen; an edict ordered the office to destroy it and strip Kangguo of two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Two-Zhe transport vice Xu Kangguo offered a gold-inlaid screen; the office was ordered to destroy it and strip him two ranks.

sentences.zh: 蠲太平州被賊之家夏稅。

translations.literal: Summer tax of Taiping families ravaged by bandits was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Summer tax was remitted for Taiping families ravaged by bandits.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚以參贊軍事劉子羽知興元府，黜王庶，復以王似知成都府。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Jun made staff adviser Liu Ziyu magistrate of Xingyuan and dismissed Wang Shu; Wang Si was again made Chengdu magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Jun set staff adviser Liu Ziyu at Xingyuan, dismissed Wang Shu, and restored Wang Si at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠至洪州，遣董旼招曹成，成聽命赴行在。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong reached Hong prefecture and sent Dong Min to induce Cao Cheng; Cheng obeyed and came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong reached Hong, sent Dong Min to induce Cao Cheng, and Cheng came to court.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅朔，李宏引兵入潭州，執馬友，殺之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin new moon: Li Hong led troops into Tan prefecture, seized Ma You, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengyin new moon: Li Hong entered Tan, seized Ma You, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李綱領兵三千發福州。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Li Gang led three thousand troops out from Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Gang marched three thousand out of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔孟庾、韓世忠班師。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: an edict ordered Meng Geng and Han Shizhong to withdraw their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Meng Geng and Han Shizhong were ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 岳飛屯駐江州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei garrisoned Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei camped at Jiang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以劉光世為甯武、甯國軍節度使，韓世忠為太尉，移屯建康府。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Liu Guangshi was made Ningwu and Ningguo military commissioner; Han Shizhong was made Grand Marshal and shifted garrison to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Liu Guangshi became Ningwu and Ningguo commissioner; Han Shizhong became Grand Marshal and shifted to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以李橫為襄、郢鎮撫使，李道鄧、隨鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Li Heng was made Xiang-Ying pacification commissioner; Li Dao was made Deng-Sui pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Heng became Xiang-Ying pacification commissioner; Li Dao became Deng-Sui commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，翟汝文罷。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zhai Ruwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhai Ruwen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 孔彥舟叛降偽齊。

translations.literal: Kong Yanzhou rebelled and surrendered to the puppet Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yanzhou rebelled and went over to puppet Qi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以權邦彥兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Quan Bangyan was additionally made acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Quan Bangyan was additionally made acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，仇悆兼制置福建路。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Qiu Yu was additionally made coastal commissioner for Fujian circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Qiu Yu was additionally made Fujian coastal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免台諫官輪對。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: censorate remonstrance officers were exempted from rotation audience.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, censorate remonstrance officers were exempted from rotation audience.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，召呂頤浩赴行在，令參謀官傅崧卿權主管都督府事。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Lü Yihao was recalled to court; staff officer Fu Songqing was made acting head of the overall command office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lü Yihao was recalled; staff officer Fu Songqing was made acting head of the overall command.

sentences.zh: 詔兩浙、江、淮守臣，令存撫東北流寓人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered two-Zhe, Jiang, and Huai defenders to shelter and soothe northeastern exiles.
translations.idiomatic: Two-Zhe, Jiang, and Huai defenders were ordered to shelter northeastern exiles.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，韓世忠遣統制解元、巨振入潭州，執李宏以歸。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Han Shizhong sent controllers Jie Yuan and Ju Zhen into Tan prefecture, seized Li Hong, and brought him back.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Han Shizhong sent Jie Yuan and Ju Zhen into Tan, seized Li Hong, and brought him in.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，悉蠲福建諸州被兵之家田稅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinyou: field tax of all Fujian families ravaged by troops was fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinyou: field tax was fully remitted for every Fujian family ravaged by troops.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復置湖北提舉茶鹽司。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the Hubei tea-and-salt commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Hubei tea-and-salt commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷福建提舉市舶司。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Fujian maritime-trade commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Fujian maritime-trade commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，起復翟琮為河南府、孟汝唐州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zhai Cong was recalled to service as Henan prefecture and Meng-Ru-Tang pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhai Cong was recalled as Henan and Meng-Ru-Tang pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷淮東路提點刑獄司。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Huaidong circuit penal commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Huaidong penal commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，馬友党郝通率兵五萬歸宣撫司。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Ma You's follower Hao Tong led fifty thousand troops to surrender to the pacification office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Ma You's follower Hao Tong brought fifty thousand troops to the pacification office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，知廬州王亨復安豐、壽春縣。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Luzhou magistrate Wang Heng recovered Anfeng and Shouchun counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Luzhou magistrate Wang Heng retook Anfeng and Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 己卯，呂頤浩入見。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Lü Yihao had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Lü Yihao was received.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，韓世忠討劉忠，駐兵于岳州之長樂渡，大破之，忠走淮西。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Han Shizhong attacked Liu Zhong, encamped at Changle ford in Yue prefecture, greatly defeated him, and Zhong fled to Huai west.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Han Shizhong struck Liu Zhong, camped at Changle ford in Yue, broke him, and Zhong fled to Huai west.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔編次建炎以來譜牒。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict ordered compilation of genealogies since the Jianyan reign.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, genealogies since Jianyan were ordered compiled.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午朔，落秦檜職。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu new moon: Qin Hui was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu new moon: Qin Hui was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷修政局。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Rehabilitation Bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Rehabilitation Bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以彗出，大赦，許中外臣民直言時政，陝西諸叛將許令自新。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: because a comet appeared, a great amnesty was proclaimed; inner and outer subjects were permitted frank counsel on current policy; Shaanxi rebel generals were permitted to renew themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, a comet brought great amnesty; subjects were told to speak plainly on policy; Shaanxi rebel generals might renew themselves.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，王倫自金國使還入見。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Wang Lun returned from the Jin state as envoy and had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wang Lun returned from the Jin as envoy and was received.

sentences.zh: 遣潘致堯等為金國軍前通問使，附茶藥金幣進兩宮。

translations.literal: Pan Zhiyao and others were sent as envoys to inquire before the Jin armies, with tea, medicine, gold, and silks offered to the two palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zhiyao and others were sent to inquire before the Jin armies, bearing tea, medicine, gold, and silks for the two palaces.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以直徽猷閣郭偉為淮西巡撫使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Direct Huaiyuan Pavilion Guo Wei was made Huai west patrol commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Guo Wei of Direct Huaiyuan Pavilion became Huai west patrol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復以朱勝非為尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhu Shengfei was again made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and concurrent Privy Council director.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhu Shengfei was again Right Vice Director, Grand Councilor, and concurrent Privy Council director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，司空山賊李通出降，以為都督府親軍統領。

translations.literal: Sikong Mountain bandit Li Tong came out to surrender and was made overall command personal-army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sikong Mountain bandit Li Tong surrendered and became overall command personal-army commander.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以右朝請大夫呂源為浙東、福建沿海制置使，治定海縣。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Right Court Gentleman Lü Yuan was made eastern Zhe and Fujian coastal commissioner, seated at Dinghai county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Lü Yuan became eastern Zhe and Fujian coastal commissioner, seated at Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 知建昌軍朱芾擊石陂賊餘照，禽斬之。

translations.literal: Jianchang army magistrate Zhu Fei attacked Shipo bandit Yu Zhao, captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fei of Jianchang struck Shipo bandit Yu Zhao, captured him, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，彗沒。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the comet vanished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，復以郭仲荀為武泰軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Guo Zhongxun was again made Wutai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Guo Zhongxun was again made Wutai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔墨敕有不當者，許三省、樞密院奏稟，給事中、中書舍人繳駁，台諫論列，有司申審。

translations.literal: An edict said that where ink edicts were improper, the Three Departments and Privy Council might report up, drafting and secretariat reviewers might rebut, censors might remonstrate, and responsible offices might review.
translations.idiomatic: Where ink edicts were improper, the Three Departments and Privy Council might report up, reviewers rebut, censors remonstrate, and offices review.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命福建提舉茶鹽官兼領市舶司。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Fujian tea-and-salt commissioner was ordered concurrently to head the maritime-trade office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Fujian tea-and-salt commissioner was ordered also to head maritime trade.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以韓世忠為江南東、西路宣撫使，他帥臣稱宣撫使者並罷。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Han Shizhong was made Jiangnan east and west circuit pacification commissioner; other commanders styled pacification commissioner were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Han Shizhong became Jiangnan east and west pacification commissioner; other commanders styled pacification commissioner were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣監察御史明橐等五人宣諭江、浙、湖、廣、福建諸路，仍降詔諭官吏以遣使按察、勸懲、誅賞之意。

translations.literal: Day renwu: five investigating censors including Ming Nang were sent to announce and instruct Jiang, Zhe, Hu, Guang, and Fujian circuits, with an edict explaining dispatch of envoys to inspect, encourage, punish, and reward.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, five investigating censors including Ming Nang were sent through Jiang, Zhe, Hu, Guang, and Fujian with an edict on inspection, encouragement, punishment, and reward.

sentences.zh: 癸未，新作行宮南門成。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the new south gate of the traveling palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the traveling palace's new south gate was completed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，提轄榷貨務張純峻立淮、浙鹽法，增其算。

translations.literal: Monopoly commissioner Zhang Chunjun established Huai and Zhe salt law and increased the levy.
translations.idiomatic: Monopoly commissioner Zhang Chunjun set Huai and Zhe salt law and raised the levy.

sentences.zh: 總領四川財賦趙開初變四川鹽法，盡榷之。

translations.literal: Sichuan finance overall controller Zhao Kai first reformed Sichuan salt law and fully monopolized it.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan finance overall Zhao Kai first reformed Sichuan salt and fully monopolized it.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Venus was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Venus was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以知興元府王似為川、陝宣撫處置副使。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Xingyuan magistrate Wang Si was made Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification and disposition deputy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Si of Xingyuan became Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封右監門衛大將軍、榮州防禦使令畤為安定郡王。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Right Gate Guard senior general and Rongzhou defense commissioner Ling Zhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Ling Zhi, senior general of Right Gate Guard and Rongzhou defense commissioner, was enfeoffed Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 是月，韓世忠遣統制解元襲擊劉忠於蘄陽，大破之。

translations.literal: That month, Han Shizhong sent controller Jie Yuan to raid Liu Zhong at Qiyang; he was greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Han Shizhong sent Jie Yuan to raid Liu Zhong at Qiyang and broke him.

sentences.zh: 忠奔劉豫。

translations.literal: Zhong fled to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong fled to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子朔，置牧馬監于饒州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi new moon: a horse-pasture office was established at Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuzi new moon: a horse-pasture office was set at Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李勃伏誅。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Li Bo was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Bo was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，初置江、浙、荊湖、廣南、福建路都轉運使。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: circuit overall transport commissioners for Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, southern Guang, and Fujian were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, circuit overall transport commissioners for Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, southern Guang, and Fujian were first set.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，潘致堯至楚州，通判州事劉晏劫其禮幣奔劉豫，守臣柴春戰死。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Pan Zhiyao reached Chuzhou; vice prefect Liu Yan robbed his ritual gifts and fled to Liu Yu; defender Chai Chun died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Pan Zhiyao reached Chu; vice prefect Liu Yan robbed his gifts and fled to Liu Yu; defender Chai Chun died fighting.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以知平江府趙鼎為江東安撫大使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Pingjiang magistrate Zhao Ding was made Jiangdong grand soothing commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhao Ding of Pingjiang became Jiangdong grand soothing commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，禁溫、台二州民結集社會。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the people of Wen and Tai prefectures were forbidden to form societies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Wen and Tai were forbidden to form societies.

sentences.zh: 班度量權衡于諸路，禁私造者。

translations.literal: Weights and measures were distributed to all circuits; private manufacture was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Weights and measures were sent to every circuit; private forging was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是月，顏孝恭招降石陂余賊李寶等。

translations.literal: That month, Yan Xiaogong induced Shipo remnant bandit Li Bao and others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yan Xiaogong induced Shipo remnant Li Bao and others to surrender.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，陳顒陷汀州武平縣，犯梅、循二州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: Chen Yong took Ting prefecture's Wuping county and raided Mei and Xun prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinyou: Chen Yong took Wuping in Ting and raided Mei and Xun.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，初榷明州鹵田鹽。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Ming prefecture salt-pan salt was first monopolized.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Ming salt-pan salt was first monopolized.

sentences.zh: 辛未，議將撫師江上，召侍從官條具利害。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: it was debated to comfort the army on the river; attendants were summoned to submit pros and cons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, comforting the army on the river was debated; attendants were summoned for pros and cons.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命李綱、劉洪道、程昌寓、解潛會兵捕討湖寇楊太。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Li Gang, Liu Hongdao, Cheng Changyu, and Xie Qian were ordered to combine forces to capture and suppress lake bandit Yang Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Li Gang, Liu Hongdao, Cheng Changyu, and Xie Qian were ordered to combine against lake bandit Yang Tai.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，范汝為餘黨范忠掠龍泉縣。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Fan Ruwei remnant Fan Zhong plundered Longquan county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Fan Ruwei remnant Fan Zhong plundered Longquan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔宣諭五使，焚所至州縣建炎以前已蠲稅籍。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the five announcing commissioners were ordered to burn tax registers already remitted before Jianyan at every prefecture and county they reached.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the five announcing commissioners were told to burn tax registers remitted before Jianyan in every place they reached.

sentences.zh: 癸未，臨安大火。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: a great fire struck Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Lin'an burned greatly.

sentences.zh: 是月，關師古敗偽齊兵於抹邦山。

translations.literal: That month, Guan Shigu defeated puppet Qi troops at Mobang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That month Guan Shigu beat puppet Qi at Mobang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 馬友党步諒詣李綱降，綱入潭州，其党郝晸降王進，吳錫禽王浚。

translations.literal: Ma You's follower Bu Liang came to Li Gang to surrender; Gang entered Tan prefecture; his follower Hao Jing surrendered to Wang Jin; Wu Xi captured Wang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Ma You's follower Bu Liang surrendered to Li Gang; Gang entered Tan; Hao Jing surrendered to Wang Jin; Wu Xi seized Wang Jun.

sentences.zh: 湖南盜賊悉平。

translations.literal: Hunan bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan bandits were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥朔，命神武前軍領申世景等討捕范忠。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai new moon: Shenwu Front Army commander Shen Shijing and others were ordered to hunt Fan Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dinghai new moon: Shen Shijing of Shenwu Front and others were ordered after Fan Zhong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，偽稱榮德帝姬易氏伏誅。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Yi, who falsely claimed to be Princess Rongde, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yi, who falsely claimed Princess Rongde, was executed.

sentences.zh: 範忠犯處州。

translations.literal: Fan Zhong raided Chu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhong raided Chu.

sentences.zh: 巨師古引兵入廬州，執王亨送行在。

translations.literal: Ju Shigu led troops into Luzhou, seized Wang Heng, and sent him to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Shigu entered Luzhou, seized Wang Heng, and sent him to court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李綱罷。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Li Gang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Gang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 臨安府火。

translations.literal: Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an burned again.

sentences.zh: 丙申，振被火家。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: families ravaged by fire were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, fire-ravaged families were relieved.

sentences.zh: 罷浙東沿海制置司。

translations.literal: The eastern Zhe coastal commissioner's office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern Zhe coastal office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，岳飛遣統領徐慶、王貴討禽萍鄉賊高聚。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Yue Fei sent commanders Xu Qing and Wang Gui to capture Pingxiang bandit Gao Ju.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Yue Fei sent Xu Qing and Wang Gui to capture Pingxiang bandit Gao Ju.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以胡舜陟為廬、壽等州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hu Shunzhi was made Lu and Shou pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hu Shunzhi became Lu and Shou pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人侵熙、秦，關師古擊敗之。

translations.literal: Jin raided Xi and Qin; Guan Shigu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin raided Xi and Qin; Guan Shigu beat them back.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣駕部員外郎李願撫諭川、陝。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Ministry of Tally outer-office member Li Yuan was sent to soothe Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Li Yuan of the Ministry of Tally was sent to soothe Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 江西兵馬副鈐轄張忠彥坐縱暴不法，斬於潭州。

translations.literal: Jiangxi deputy military controller Zhang Zhongyan, for indulging violence and lawlessness, was executed at Tan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhongyan, Jiangxi deputy military controller, was executed at Tan for indulging violence and lawlessness.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，程昌寓遣杜湛討楊欽等，敗之，殺三千餘人。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan against Yang Qin and others, defeated them, and killed more than three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan against Yang Qin, broke them, and killed more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，川、陝宣撫司類試陝西發解進士，得周謨等十三人，以便宜賜進士出身。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office held a classified examination of Shaanxi presented scholars; Zhou Mo and twelve others received jinshi origin by expedient grant.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office classified Shaanxi presented scholars; Zhou Mo and twelve others received jinshi origin by grant.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷張浚宣撫處置使，仍知樞密院。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zhang Jun was dismissed as pacification and disposition commissioner but still directed the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhang Jun was dismissed as pacification commissioner but still directed the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 以知夔州盧法原為川、陝宣撫處置副使，及王似同治司事。

translations.literal: Kuizhou magistrate Lu Fayuan was made Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification and disposition deputy commissioner, sharing office with Wang Si.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Fayuan of Kuizhou became Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification deputy commissioner, sharing office with Wang Si.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣司封員外郎周隨亨同撫諭川、陝。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Ministry of Rites outer-office member Zhou Suiheng was sent jointly to soothe Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhou Suiheng of the Ministry of Rites was sent jointly to soothe Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，孟庾自建康來朝。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Meng Geng came to audience from Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Meng Geng came from Jiankang to audience.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金人犯商州，守將邵隆退屯上津。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Jin attacked Shang prefecture; defender Shao Long withdrew to camp at Shangjin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Jin hit Shang; defender Shao Long withdrew to Shangjin.

sentences.zh: 李橫敗偽齊兵，復汝州。

translations.literal: Li Heng defeated puppet Qi troops and recovered Ru prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng beat puppet Qi and retook Ru.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命孟庾同都督江、淮、荊、浙諸軍事。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Meng Geng was ordered jointly to command Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Meng Geng was ordered jointly to command Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 詔都督府總治江東西、湖北、浙西帥臣經畫屯田。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the overall command to oversee garrison-farm planning for Jiang east and west, Hubei, and western Zhe commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The overall command was ordered to oversee garrison farms for Jiang east and west, Hubei, and western Zhe commanders.

sentences.zh: 張浚承制以歸州隸夔州路。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun by commission made Gui prefecture subordinate to Kuizhou circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun by commission made Gui subordinate to Kuizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 是冬，金人犯和尚原，將士乏食自潰，吳璘拔砦棄去。

translations.literal: That winter, Jin attacked Heshang plain; troops lacked food and scattered themselves; Wu Lin abandoned the stockade and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Jin hit Heshang plain; troops starved and scattered; Wu Lin abandoned the stockade and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 虔賊謝達犯惠州。

translations.literal: Gan bandit Xie Da raided Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gan bandit Xie Da raided Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳朔，帝在臨安，率百官遙拜二帝，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 3, spring, first month, day dingsi new moon: the emperor was at Lin'an; he led the hundred officials in bowing from afar to the two emperors and did not receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 3, spring, dingsi new moon: at Lin'an the emperor led the hundred officials in bowing from afar to the two emperors and took no New Year court.

sentences.zh: 江西將李宗諒誘戍兵叛，寇筠州，統領趙進擊卻之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi officer Li Zongliang induced garrison troops to rebel and raided Yun prefecture; commander Zhao Jin beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi officer Li Zongliang induced the garrison to rebel and hit Yun; commander Zhao Jin drove them back.

sentences.zh: 翟琮入西京，禽偽齊留守孟邦雄。

translations.literal: Zhai Cong entered the Western Capital and captured puppet Qi garrison commissioner Meng Bangxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Cong entered the Western Capital and seized puppet Qi garrison commissioner Meng Bangxiong.

sentences.zh: 命諸路憲臣兼提舉常平司。

translations.literal: Circuit penal commissioners were ordered concurrently to head the Ever-Normal granary office.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit penal commissioners were ordered also to head the Ever-Normal granary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金人犯上津。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Jin attacked Shangjin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Jin hit Shangjin.

sentences.zh: 李橫破潁順軍，偽齊知軍蘭和降。

translations.literal: Li Heng broke Yingshun army; puppet Qi commander Lan He surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng broke Yingshun army; puppet Qi commander Lan He surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，金人犯金州洵陽縣。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Jin attacked Xunyang county in Jin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Jin hit Xunyang in Jin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以仇悆為福建、兩浙、淮東路沿海制置使。

translations.literal: Qiu Yu was made coastal commissioner for Fujian, two Zhe, and Huaidong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yu became coastal commissioner for Fujian, two Zhe, and Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，陳顒圍潮州不下，引兵趨江西。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Chen Yong besieged Chaozhou without taking it and led troops toward Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Chen Yong besieged Chaozhou, could not take it, and turned toward Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，李橫復潁昌府。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Li Heng recovered Yingchang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Heng retook Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔中外刑官各務仁平，台憲檢察，月具所平反以聞，歲終考察殿最。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict ordered criminal judges within and without to pursue humanity and fairness; the censorate was to inspect; each month reversed cases were reported; at year's end merit was assessed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, criminal judges within and without were told to pursue humanity and fairness; the censorate would inspect; reversed cases were reported monthly; merit was assessed at year's end.

sentences.zh: 金人陷金州，鎮撫使王彥焚積聚，退保西鄉。

translations.literal: Jin took Jin prefecture; pacification commissioner Wang Yan burned stores and withdrew to defend Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Jin; pacification commissioner Wang Yan burned stores and fell back to Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷行在宗正司，命嗣濮王仲湜兼判大宗正事。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the mobile-court Imperial Clan office was abolished; Heir Apparent Prince of Pu Zhong Mi was ordered concurrently to judge Grand Clan Director affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the mobile-court Imperial Clan office was abolished; Heir Apparent Prince of Pu Zhong Mi was told to judge Grand Clan Director affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，震電雨雹。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: thunder, lightning, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, thunder, lightning, and hail fell.

sentences.zh: 造渾天儀。

translations.literal: An armillary sphere was made.
translations.idiomatic: An armillary sphere was constructed.

sentences.zh: 李通為其徒王全所殺。

translations.literal: Li Tong was killed by his follower Wang Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tong was killed by his follower Wang Quan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命西外宗正移司福州。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the western outer Imperial Clan directorate was ordered to move its office to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the western outer Imperial Clan office was ordered to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復祭大火。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: sacrifice to the Great Fire star was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, sacrifice to the Great Fire star was restored.

sentences.zh: 以湯東野為淮東安撫使。

translations.literal: Tang Dongye was made Huai east pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Dongye became Huai east pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以李橫為襄陽府、鄧隨郢州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Li Heng was made Xiangyang superior prefecture and Deng-Sui-E prefectures pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Li Heng was made pacification commissioner of Xiangyang and Deng, Sui, and E.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，登、萊山砦統制范溫率部兵泛海來歸。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Deng-Lai mountain stockade overall controller Fan Wen led his troops by sea to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Fan Wen of the Deng-Lai mountain stockades came over by sea with his command.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔春秋望祭諸陵。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered spring and autumn lookout sacrifices at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, spring and autumn lookout sacrifices at the tombs were ordered.

sentences.zh: 張浚論奏王似不可為副，因引罪求罷，不報。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun memorialized that Wang Si could not serve as deputy and, citing guilt, begged dismissal; no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun argued Wang Si was unfit as deputy, begged dismissal on his own account, and received no answer.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔民復業者，視墾田多寡定租額賦役。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict ordered that for people returning to farming, rent and corvée should be set by how much land they reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, returnees were to have rent and corvée fixed by reclaimed acreage.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，減淮、浙蠶鹽錢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Huai and Zhe silk-salt tax money was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Huai and Zhe silk-salt levies were cut.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥朔，升桂州為靜江府。

translations.literal: Second month, dinghai new moon: Gui prefecture was promoted to Jingjiang superior prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai new moon: Gui was raised to Jingjiang superior prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，權邦彥薨。

translations.literal: Day jichou: acting chief councilor Quan Bangyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, acting chief councilor Quan Bangyan died.

sentences.zh: 浙東賊彭友犯龍泉縣。

translations.literal: Zhe east bandit Peng You attacked Longquan county.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe east bandit Peng You struck Longquan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李通餘黨劉德圍舒州。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Li Tong's remnant Liu De besieged Shu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Tong's remnant Liu De besieged Shu.

sentences.zh: 吳玠遇金人于饒風關，王彥自西鄉來會，金人分兵攻關，統制郭仲敗走。

translations.literal: Wu Jie met Jin troops at Raofeng Pass; Wang Yan came from Xixiang to join him; the Jin divided forces to attack the pass; controller Guo Zhong was beaten and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie met the Jin at Raofeng Pass; Wang Yan joined from Xixiang; the Jin split to storm the pass; Guo Zhong was routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，饒風關破，玠趣西縣，彥奔達州，四川大震。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Raofeng Pass fell; Jie hurried to Xi county; Yan fled to Da prefecture; Sichuan was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Raofeng Pass fell; Jie rushed to Xi; Yan fled to Da; Sichuan shook.

sentences.zh: 張浚被罷職之命，以諸軍方潰，因秘不行，復具奏審。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun received the order to dismiss, but because the armies were breaking he kept it secret and memorialized again for review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun got his dismissal order, but with the armies collapsing he hid it and memorialized again for review.

sentences.zh: 己亥，金帥撒離曷入興元府，經略使劉子羽焚其城走三泉縣，吳玠退屯仙人關。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Jin commander Saliyehe entered Xingyuan superior prefecture; circuit commissioner Liu Ziyu burned the city and fled to Sanquan county; Wu Jie withdrew to camp at Xianren Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Saliyehe entered Xingyuan; Liu Ziyu burned the city and fled to Sanquan; Wu Jie fell back to Xianren Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以宗子伯琮為和州防禦使，賜名瑗，尋改貴州。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: imperial clansman Bozong was made Defender of He prefecture and given the name Yuan; soon he was moved to Gui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, clansman Bozong became Defender of He and was named Yuan; soon he was shifted to Gui.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，蠲廣東諸州被賊民家稅。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: tax on Guangdong circuits' households ravaged by bandits was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, tax on Guangdong households hit by bandits was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄭州兵馬鈐轄牛皋、彭玘率兵與李橫會，橫以便宜命皋為蔡、唐州鎮撫使，玘知汝州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zheng prefecture controller Niu Gao and Peng Qi led troops to join Li Heng; Heng on his own authority made Gao pacification commissioner of Cai and Tang and Qi prefect magistrate of Ru.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Niu Gao and Peng Qi of Zheng joined Li Heng; Heng on his own authority made Gao Cai-Tang pacification commissioner and Qi magistrate of Ru.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，翟琮遣統制李吉敗偽齊兵于伊陽，又殲其將梁進之眾。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zhai Cong sent controller Li Ji to defeat puppet Qi troops at Yiyang and annihilate commander Liang Jin's force.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhai Cong sent Li Ji to beat puppet Qi at Yiyang and wipe out Liang Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，王似始受宣撫副使之命。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Wang Si at last accepted the commission as pacification deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wang Si finally took the pacification deputy commission.

sentences.zh: 戊申，虔賊周十隆犯循、梅、汀州，詔統制趙祥等合兵捕之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Gan bandit Zhou Shilong attacked Xun, Mei, and Ting; controllers Zhao Xiang and others were ordered to unite troops to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Gan bandit Zhou Shilong hit Xun, Mei, and Ting; Zhao Xiang and other controllers were told to unite and take him.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以李橫為神武左軍副統制、京西招撫使。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Li Heng was made Divine Martial Left Army deputy overall controller and Jing west recruitment commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Heng became Divine Martial Left deputy overall controller and Jing west recruitment commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改胡舜陟為淮西安撫使。

translations.literal: Hu Shunzhi was changed to Huai west pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shunzhi was shifted to Huai west pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以工部尚書席益參知政事，翰林學士徐俯簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Works Minister Xi Yi was made Vice Grand Councilor; Hanlin academician Xu Fu was made Privy Council signing officer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Works Minister Xi Yi became Vice Grand Councilor; Hanlin academician Xu Fu signed at the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王全犯廬州。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wang Quan attacked Lu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Quan attacked Lu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔守臣至官半年，具上民間利害或邊防五事。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: an edict ordered that after half a year in office defenders should submit five items on popular welfare or frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, defenders were told that after six months they must submit five items on popular welfare or the frontier.

sentences.zh: 李橫遣人奏潁昌之捷，詔許橫便宜行事。

translations.literal: Li Heng sent word of victory at Yingchang; an edict allowed Heng discretionary action.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng reported victory at Yingchang; he was allowed to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，劉光世遣酈瓊等屯兵泗州為李橫聲援。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Liu Guangshi sent Li Qiong and others to camp at Si prefecture in support of Li Heng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Liu Guangshi sent Li Qiong and others to Si to back Li Heng.

sentences.zh: 是月，張浚復以王庶為參謀官，往巴州措置。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Jun again made Wang Shu staff planning officer and sent him to settle affairs at Ba prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Jun again made Wang Shu planning officer and sent him to Ba.

sentences.zh: 時金兵深入至金牛鎮，疑有伏，由褒斜谷引兵還興元，吳玠、劉子羽追擊其後，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: At that time Jin troops had penetrated to Jinniu post; suspecting ambush, they led their army back through Baoxie Valley to Xingyuan; Wu Jie and Liu Ziyu pursued and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops had reached Jinniu post; fearing ambush, they withdrew through Baoxie Valley to Xingyuan; Wu Jie and Liu Ziyu pursued and took a heavy toll.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，詔岳飛捕虔賊。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: an edict ordered Yue Fei to capture Gan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei: Yue Fei was ordered against Gan bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，申命統制巨師古部兵萬人屯揚州。

translations.literal: Day renxu: overall controller Ju Shigu was again ordered to camp ten thousand troops at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ju Shigu was again told to camp ten thousand at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 胡舜陟至廬州，王全降。

translations.literal: Hu Shunzhi reached Lu prefecture and Wang Quan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shunzhi reached Lu and Wang Quan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以趙鼎為江西安撫大使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Zhao Ding was made Jiangxi pacification grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhao Ding became Jiangxi pacification grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李橫傳檄諸軍收復東京。

translations.literal: Li Heng issued a proclamation to the armies to recover the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng proclaimed to the armies the recovery of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，金人遣兵援劉豫，李橫敗走，潁昌復陷。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Jin sent troops to aid Liu Yu; Li Heng was beaten and fled; Yingchang fell again.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Jin sent troops to Liu Yu; Li Heng was routed and Yingchang fell again.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以韓世忠為淮南東路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Han Shizhong was made Huainan east-route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Han Shizhong became Huainan east-route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李綱遣兵擊降李宗諒，詔戮於市。

translations.literal: Li Gang sent troops to attack and induce Li Zongliang to surrender; an edict ordered execution in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang sent troops, took Li Zongliang's surrender, and court ordered him beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，朱勝非以母喪去位。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dinghai: Zhu Shengfei left office on his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dinghai: Zhu Shengfei left on his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 偽齊知虢州董震及其統制董先來歸，以震權商、虢、陝州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi Guo prefecture magistrate Dong Zhen and his controller Dong Xian came over; Zhen was made acting Shang-Guo-Shan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi magistrate Dong Zhen and controller Dong Xian came over; Zhen was made acting Shang-Guo-Shan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔江東西、湖北、浙西募民佃荒田，蠲三年租。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict ordered Jiang east and west, Hubei, and Zhe west to recruit commoners to farm waste land and remit three years' rent.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Jiang east and west, Hubei, and Zhe west were told to recruit farmers for waste land and remit three years' rent.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以劉光世為檢校太傅、江南東路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Liu Guangshi was made acting Grand Mentor and Jiangnan east-route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Liu Guangshi became acting Grand Mentor and Jiangnan east-route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人去興元。

translations.literal: Jin withdrew from Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin left Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，徙都督府于鎮江。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the commander-in-chief's office was moved to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the commander-in-chief's office was moved to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 岳飛軍次虔州。

translations.literal: Yue Fei's army halted at Gan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei halted at Gan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，偽齊知唐州胡安中來歸。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: puppet Qi Tang prefecture magistrate Hu Anzhong came over.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, puppet Qi Tang magistrate Hu Anzhong came over.

sentences.zh: 丙申，偽齊李成攻陷虢州，董先、牛皋奔襄陽。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: puppet Qi Li Cheng attacked and took Guo prefecture; Dong Xian and Niu Gao fled to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, puppet Qi Li Cheng took Guo; Dong Xian and Niu Gao fled to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改諡昭慈獻烈皇后為昭慈聖獻。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the posthumous title of Empress Zhaoci Xianlie was changed to Zhaoci Shengxian.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Empress Zhaoci Xianlie was retitled Zhaoci Shengxian.

sentences.zh: 復舉五帝日月之祀。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to the Five Emperors, sun, and moon was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice to the Five Emperors, sun, and moon was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚子，增文武小官奉。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: stipends for minor civil and military officials were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, stipends for minor officials were raised.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，荊南統制羅廣率兵至鼎州。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Jingnan controller Luo Guang led troops to Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jingnan controller Luo Guang marched to Ding.

sentences.zh: 楊太眾益盛，自號大聖天王，立鐘相少子子義為太子，廣等不克討而還。

translations.literal: Yang Yao grew stronger, styled himself Great Sage Heavenly King, set Zhong Xiang's younger son Ziyi as crown prince; Guang and others could not suppress him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yao grew bold, called himself Great Sage Heavenly King, made Zhong Xiang's son Ziyi crown prince; Guang could not crush him and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 丁未，岳飛遣統領張憲、王貴擊彭友，禽斬之。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Yue Fei sent commanders Zhang Xian and Wang Gui to attack Peng You; he was captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yue Fei sent Zhang Xian and Wang Gui against Peng You; he was taken and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 劉忠為部下王林所殺，傳首行在。

translations.literal: Liu Zhong was killed by his subordinate Wang Lin; his head was sent to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhong was killed by Wang Lin; his head was sent to court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以浙西兵馬鈐轄史康民所部兵為忠銳第九將。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the troops under Zhe west controller Shi Kangmin were made the Loyal Sharp Ninth Command.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Shi Kangmin's Zhe west command became the Loyal Sharp Ninth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張浚奏王庶、王似、盧法原威望素輕，乞命劉子羽、吳玠並為判官，不報。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Zhang Jun memorialized that Wang Shu, Wang Si, and Lu Fayuan had always been light in prestige and begged that Liu Ziyu and Wu Jie both be made judges; no reply.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zhang Jun said Wang Shu, Wang Si, and Lu Fayuan lacked weight and begged Liu Ziyu and Wu Jie as judges; no answer.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徐文叛奔偽齊。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Xu Wen rebelled and fled to puppet Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Xu Wen rebelled and fled to puppet Qi.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，以翟琮為河南府、孟汝鄭州鎮撫使，董先為副使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: Zhai Cong was made Henan superior prefecture and Meng-Ru-Zheng pacification commissioner; Dong Xian was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen: Zhai Cong became Henan and Meng-Ru-Zheng pacification commissioner; Dong Xian was deputy.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣樞密計議官任直清撫諭襄陽、商、虢、河南諸鎮。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Privy Council planning officer Ren Zhiqing was sent to soothe Xiangyang, Shang, Guo, and Henan garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Privy Council planner Ren Zhiqing was sent to soothe Xiangyang, Shang, Guo, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 己未，命楊沂中招捕嚴州盜賊。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Yang Yizhong was ordered to recruit and capture Yan prefecture bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yang Yizhong was ordered to recruit and take Yan bandits.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，建睦親宅。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Kindred Princes Residence was built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Kindred Princes Residence was built.

sentences.zh: 以董先為商、虢、陝州鎮撫使。

translations.literal: Dong Xian was made Shang-Guo-Shan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Xian became Shang-Guo-Shan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 徵河南布衣王忠民為宣教郎，至行在，辭不受。

translations.literal: Henan commoner Wang Zhongmin was summoned as Instructor Gentleman; he reached the mobile court and declined appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Henan commoner Wang Zhongmin was summoned as Instructor Gentleman; he reached court and declined.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，潘致堯還，言金人欲重臣通使以取信，遂寢出師之議。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Pan Zhiyao returned and said the Jin wanted a high minister as envoy to gain trust; the plan to send troops was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Pan Zhiyao returned saying the Jin wanted a high minister as envoy for trust; the eastern campaign was shelved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷諸州在任守臣所辟通判。

translations.literal: Day yichou: acting prefectural defenders' privately recruited vice prefects were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, defenders' private vice prefect recruits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以韓肖胄等充金國軍前通問使。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Han Xiaozhou and others were made Jin army front inquiry envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Han Xiaozhou and others were made Jin front inquiry envoys.

sentences.zh: 安化蠻犯邊，廣西經略使許中發兵擊之。

translations.literal: Anhua Man raided the border; Guangxi commissioner Xu Zhong sent troops to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Anhua Man hit the border; Guangxi commissioner Xu Zhong sent troops against them.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，楊沂中招降嚴州賊繆羅等，捕斬其徒百人，魔賊平。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Yang Yizhong induced Yan prefecture bandits Miao Luo and others to surrender and captured and beheaded a hundred followers; demon-bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yang Yizhong won Yan bandits Miao Luo and others, beheaded a hundred followers, and demon-bandits were quiet.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以岳州數被兵，免今年稅役。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: because Yue prefecture had repeatedly suffered troops, this year's tax and corvée were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yue's taxes and corvée were remitted for repeated warfare.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔守、令、尉、佐，境內妖民聚集不能覺察致亂者，並坐罪。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict ordered that defenders, magistrates, and assistants who failed to detect heterodox gatherings in their districts and thereby allowed revolt would all be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, defenders, magistrates, and assistants who missed heterodox gatherings and let revolt rise were all to be punished.

sentences.zh: 知建昌軍朱芾討南豐縣賊，禽誅其魁黃琛。

translations.literal: Jianchang army magistrate Zhu Fei suppressed Nanfeng county bandits and captured and executed their chief Huang Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fei of Jianchang crushed Nanfeng bandits and executed chief Huang Chen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以方與金國議和，禁邊兵犯齊境。

translations.literal: Day yihai: because peace was being discussed with the Jin state, frontier troops were forbidden to raid Qi territory.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, with Jin peace talks under way, frontier troops were forbidden to raid Qi territory.

sentences.zh: 丙子，王彥復金州，金兵棄均、房去。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Wang Yan recovered Jin prefecture; Jin troops abandoned Jun and Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Wang Yan retook Jin; the Jin left Jun and Fang.

sentences.zh: 韓世忠請以大軍還鎮江。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong begged to return the main army to Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong begged to bring the main army back to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔淮南統制解元戍泗州，餘屯江北。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered Huainan controllers to garrison Si; the rest camped north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Huainan controllers were told to hold Si; the rest camped north of the river.

sentences.zh: 周隨亨、李願宣押王似、盧法原至閬州，張浚始解使事。

translations.literal: Zhou Suiheng and Li Yuan escorted Wang Si and Lu Fayuan to Lang prefecture; Zhang Jun at last relinquished the commission.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Suiheng and Li Yuan escorted Wang Si and Lu Fayuan to Lang; Zhang Jun finally gave up the commission.

sentences.zh: 時已論金牛之功，以吳玠為利州路、階成鳳州制置使，劉子羽為寶文閣直學士，王彥為保大軍承宣使，僚屬將帥第賞有差。

translations.literal: By then Jinniu merit had been debated; Wu Jie was made Lizhou circuit and Jie-Cheng-Feng pacification commissioner, Liu Ziyu Baowen Hall direct academician, Wang Yan Bao Great Army commissioner, and staff, commanders, and generals were rewarded by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jinniu merit was weighed; Wu Jie became Lizhou and Jie-Cheng-Feng commissioner, Liu Ziyu Baowen direct academician, Wang Yan Bao Great Army commissioner, and staff and generals were graded in reward.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，浚及子羽、王庶、劉錫等赴行在。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Jun with Ziyu, Wang Shu, and Liu Xi and others went to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jun with Ziyu, Wang Shu, Liu Xi, and others reached court.

sentences.zh: 詔李橫等收軍還鎮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Heng and others to gather their armies and return to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng and others were told to gather their armies and return to post.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷宣撫司便宜黜陟。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: discretionary promotion and demotion by the pacification office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, pacification discretionary promotion and demotion was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申朔，統制巨師古坐違韓世忠節制，除名、廣州編管。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiashen new moon: controller Ju Shigu, for violating Han Shizhong's command, was struck from the rolls and assigned to Guangzhou registry control.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiashen new moon: Ju Shigu, for defying Han Shizhong, was struck from the rolls and sent to Guangzhou registry control.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復置六部架閣庫。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Six Ministries archive depot was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Six Ministries archive depot was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁諸路招納淮北人及中原軍來歸者。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: each circuit was forbidden to recruit north-of-Huai people and Central Plain soldiers coming over.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, circuits were forbidden to recruit north-of-Huai people and Central Plain deserters.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復元祐宰相呂大防官職，贈諡。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Yuanyou chancellor Lü Dafang's office and posthumous title were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Yuanyou chancellor Lü Dafang's office and posthumous title were restored.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔降川、陝死罪囚，釋流以下。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an edict reduced capital punishment in Sichuan and Shaanxi and released those below exile.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Sichuan and Shaanxi capital sentences were reduced and those below exile were freed.

sentences.zh: 賞吳玠、關師古將士。

translations.literal: Wu Jie's and Guan Shigu's officers and soldiers were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers of Wu Jie and Guan Shigu were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，張浚至綿州，復奏王似不可任。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Zhang Jun reached Mian prefecture and again memorialized that Wang Si was unfit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Zhang Jun reached Mian and again said Wang Si was unfit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命王𤫉率諸軍討楊太。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Wang Xie was ordered to lead the armies against Yang Yao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wang Xie was ordered to lead the armies against Yang Yao.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷沿海制置司。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the coastal pacification office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the coastal pacification office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，置國子監及博士弟子員。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Directorate of Education and its doctoral and student posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Directorate of Education and its doctoral and student posts were set up.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以王林所部兵為忠銳第十將。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Lin's command was made the Loyal Sharp Tenth.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wang Lin's command became the Loyal Sharp Tenth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，岳飛自虔州班師。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Yue Fei withdrew his army from Gan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yue Fei withdrew from Gan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發兵屯駐虔、廣二州，彈壓盜賊，州各三千人。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: troops were sent to garrison Gan and Guang, three thousand per prefecture, to overawe bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, troops were sent to Gan and Guang, three thousand each, to overawe bandits.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人圍方山原，王似命吳玠發兵救之。

translations.literal: That month, Jin troops besieged Fangshan plain; Wang Si ordered Wu Jie to send troops to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Jin besieged Fangshan plain; Wang Si ordered Wu Jie to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，復置博學宏詞科。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiwei: the Erudite macro-phrase examination was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiwei: the Erudite macro-phrase examination was restored.

sentences.zh: 初許任子就試。

translations.literal: Sons of officials were first allowed to sit for it.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of officials were first allowed to sit for it.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以久旱，償州縣和市民物之直。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because of long drought, prefectures and counties were ordered to pay market price for requisitioned goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, after long drought, counties were told to pay market price for requisitions.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔訪求累朝勳臣曹彬等三百人子孫，以備錄用。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict sought descendants of successive dynasties' merit ministers such as Cao Bin, three hundred persons, for possible appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, court sought three hundred descendants of merit ministers such as Cao Bin for possible appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，王𤫉以舟師發行在。
