translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wang Xie led his fleet from the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Xie led his fleet from court.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔減膳，禁屠，弛工役，罷苛嬈，命兩浙及諸路憲臣親按部錄囚。

translations.literal: Day jisi: an edict reduced the imperial table, forbade slaughter, relaxed labor service, abolished harsh exactions, and ordered Liang-Zhe and each circuit surveillance commissioners personally to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the table was cut, slaughter forbidden, labor eased, harsh levies ended, and Liang-Zhe and each circuit's surveillance commissioners were told to review prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蠲紹興二年和市絁帛。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Shaoxing year 2 government-purchase silk was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Shaoxing year 2 government-purchase silk was remitted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，呂頤浩等以旱乞罷政，帝賜詔曰：「與其去位，曷若同寅協恭，交修不逮，思所以克厭天心者。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Lü Yihao and others, on account of drought, begged to leave office; the Emperor bestowed an edict saying: "Rather than leave your posts, how much better to work as colleagues in harmony, jointly mend shortcomings, and think how to satisfy Heaven's mind."
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Lü Yihao and others begged out over drought; the Emperor replied: "Rather than quit, work as colleagues in harmony, mend what falls short, and seek what satisfies Heaven."

sentences.zh: 」頤浩等乃復視事。

translations.literal: Yihao and the others then resumed their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao and the others then returned to office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，朱勝非起復。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Zhu Shengfei returned from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhu Shengfei returned from mourning.

sentences.zh: 丙子，泉州水溢，壞城。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Quanzhou flooded and the walls were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Quanzhou flooded and the walls were ruined.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣中使逆趣張浚於道。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: a palace envoy was sent to hurry Zhang Jun on the road.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, a palace envoy was sent to hurry Zhang Jun on the road.

sentences.zh: 是月，四川霖雨、地震。

translations.literal: That month, Sichuan had long rain and earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Sichuan had long rain and earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，詔岳飛赴行在，留精兵萬人戍江州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: an edict ordered Yue Fei to come to the mobile court and leave ten thousand picked troops to garrison Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jichou: Yue Fei was ordered to court, leaving ten thousand elite at Jiang.

sentences.zh: 翟琮率兵突圍奔襄陽，詔屯駐其地。

translations.literal: Zhai Cong led troops to break out and flee to Xiangyang; an edict ordered him to camp there.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Cong broke out to Xiangyang; he was ordered to camp there.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷諸路輸禁軍闕額錢。

translations.literal: Day guimao: each circuit's payment of shortfall funds for the forbidden army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, circuit payments of forbidden-army shortfall funds were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以雨暘不時，蘇、湖地震，求直言。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: because rain and drought were untimely and Su and Hu had earthquakes, blunt counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, with untimely rain and drought and earthquakes in Su and Hu, blunt counsel was sought.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復置史館修撰、直館檢討官，命郎官兼領著作郎及佐郎。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Historiography compiler and direct archive examiner posts were restored; bureau officers were ordered concurrently to hold Compiler and Assistant Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Historiography compiler and direct archive examiner were restored; bureau officers were to hold Compiler and Assistant Compiler concurrently.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷都轉運司。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the metropolitan transport commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the metropolitan transport commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔湖南丁米三分之二均取于民田，其一取之丁口。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered that in Hunan two-thirds of the ding rice levy be taken from civilian fields and one-third from ding mouths.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Hunan was told to take two-thirds of ding rice from fields and one-third from registered mouths.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，孟庾自軍中來朝。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Meng Yu came to court from the army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Meng Yu came to court from the army.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，呂頤浩罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: Lü Yihao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuwu: Lü Yihao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔凡遇水旱災異，監司、郡守即具奏毋隱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that whenever flood, drought, or strange disasters occurred, surveillance commissioners and prefectural defenders should report at once and not conceal.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever flood, drought, or omens struck, surveillance commissioners and defenders were to report at once and not hide it.

sentences.zh: 庚申，岳飛自江州來朝。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Yue Fei came to court from Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Yue Fei came to court from Jiang.

sentences.zh: 川、陝統領官吳勝敗偽齊兵于黃堆砦。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi overall commander Wu Sheng defeated puppet Qi troops at Huangdui stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan-Shaanxi commander Wu Sheng beat puppet Qi at Huangdui stockade.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以趙鼎為江西安撫制置大使。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zhao Ding was made Jiangxi pacification and disposition grand commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhao Ding became Jiangxi pacification and disposition grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔中書舍人、給事中，凡制敕非軍期機速，必先書押而後報行。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict ordered Secretariat drafters and reviewing officers that, except for urgent military matters, all edicts must be signed before issuance.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, drafters and reviewing officers were told that except urgent military business all edicts must be signed before issue.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，偽齊王彥先寇徐、宿二州。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: puppet Qi Wang Yanxian raided Xu and Su prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, puppet Qi Wang Yanxian raided Xu and Su.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以劉光世為江東、淮西宣撫使，置司池州；

translations.literal: Day yihai: Liu Guangshi was made Jiang east and Huai west pacification commissioner, office at Chizhou;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Liu Guangshi became Jiang east and Huai west pacification commissioner at Chizhou;

sentences.zh: 韓世忠為鎮江建康府、淮南東路宣撫使，置司鎮江府；

translations.literal: Han Shizhong was made Zhenjiang-Jiankang and Huainan east-route pacification commissioner, office at Zhenjiang;
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong became Zhenjiang-Jiankang and Huainan east-route pacification commissioner at Zhenjiang;

sentences.zh: 王𤫉為荆南府、岳鄂潭鼎澧黃州漢陽軍制置使，置司鄂州；

translations.literal: Wang Xie was made Jingnan, Yue-E-Tan-Ding-Li-Huang, and Hanyang army disposition commissioner, office at E;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xie became Jingnan, Yue-E-Tan-Ding-Li-Huang, and Hanyang disposition commissioner at E;

sentences.zh: 岳飛為江南西路、舒蘄州制置使，置司江州；

translations.literal: Yue Fei was made Jiangnan west-route and Shu-Qi pacification commissioner, office at Jiang;
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei became Jiangnan west-route and Shu-Qi commissioner at Jiang;

sentences.zh: 主管殿前司郭仲荀知明州，兼沿海制置使，神武中軍統制楊沂中兼權殿前司。

translations.literal: Palace Front commander Guo Zhongxun was made Ming prefecture magistrate and concurrent coastal disposition commissioner; Divine Martial Center Army controller Yang Yizhong was made acting Palace Front commander.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front commander Guo Zhongxun became Ming magistrate and coastal disposition commissioner; Yang Yizhong of the Divine Martial Center was acting Palace Front commander.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吳勝克蓮花城。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Wu Sheng took Lotus City.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Wu Sheng took Lotus City.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，朱勝非上《重修吏部七司敕令格式》。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: Zhu Shengfei presented the Revised Ministry of Personnel Seven Bureaus Statutes and Forms.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiwei: Zhu Shengfei presented the Revised Ministry of Personnel Seven Bureaus Statutes and Forms.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，加吳玠檢校少保。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Wu Jie was advanced to acting Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Wu Jie was advanced to acting Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，趣王𤫉進兵。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wang Xie was urgently ordered to advance his army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wang Xie was urgently told to advance.

sentences.zh: 詔寬私鹽重法。

translations.literal: An edict relaxed the heavy law on private salt.
translations.idiomatic: The heavy law on private salt was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，卻大理國入貢。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Dali Kingdom tribute was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Dali tribute was declined.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，殘破州縣視戶口增損立守令考課法。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: for ravaged prefectures and counties, a defender assessment law was set according to household increase or decrease.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, ravaged prefectures and counties got defender assessment by household gain or loss.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁州縣擅增置稅場。

translations.literal: Day jihai: prefectures and counties were forbidden to add tax posts on their own.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, prefectures and counties were forbidden to add tax posts on their own.

sentences.zh: 偽齊李成陷鄧州。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi Li Cheng took Deng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi Li Cheng took Deng.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，南丹蠻莫公晟圍觀州，焚寶積監，殺知監陳烈。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Nandan Man Mo Gongcheng besieged Guan prefecture, burned Baoji supervisor post, and killed supervisor Chen Lie.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Nandan Man Mo Gongcheng besieged Guan, burned Baoji post, and killed supervisor Chen Lie.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，偽齊兵逼襄陽，李橫以糧盡，棄城奔荊南，知隨州李道亦棄城去。

translations.literal: Day renyin: puppet Qi troops pressed Xiangyang; Li Heng, out of grain, abandoned the city and fled to Jingnan; Suizhou magistrate Li Dao also abandoned his post.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, puppet Qi pressed Xiangyang; Li Heng, out of grain, fled to Jingnan; Suizhou magistrate Li Dao also fled.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，王𤫉討湖賊，戰於鼎口，不利。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Wang Xie attacked lake bandits; battle at Ding mouth went badly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wang Xie fought lake bandits at Ding mouth and lost.

sentences.zh: 偽齊陷郢州，守臣李簡棄城去。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi took E prefecture; defender Li Jian abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi took E; defender Li Jian fled.

sentences.zh: 申禁私役戰士。

translations.literal: An edict forbade private impressment of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Private impressment of soldiers was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命三省除銓曹奸弊。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Three Departments were ordered to purge Personnel Bureau abuses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Three Departments were told to purge Personnel Bureau abuses.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷諸路類省試。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: each circuit's classified provincial examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, each circuit's classified provincial examination was abolished.

sentences.zh: 統制石世達及杜湛合兵大破湖賊黃誠于龍陽洲。

translations.literal: Controllers Shi Shida and Du Zhan united troops and heavily defeated lake bandit Huang Cheng at Longyang ford.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shida and Du Zhan united and heavily defeated lake bandit Huang Cheng at Longyang ford.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，復置宗正少卿及寺監諸丞。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Imperial Clan vice director and directorate bureau posts were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Imperial Clan vice director and directorate bureau posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 是月，王彥先引兵至北壽春，將渡淮。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Yanxian led troops to North Shouchun and was about to cross the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Yanxian reached North Shouchun and was about to cross the Huai.

sentences.zh: 劉光世駐軍建康，扼馬家渡；

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi camped at Jiankang and blocked Majia ford;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi camped at Jiankang and blocked Majia ford;

sentences.zh: 又遣酈瓊駐無為軍，為廬、濠聲援。

translations.literal: He also sent Li Qiong to garrison Wuwei army as support for Lu and Hao.
translations.idiomatic: he also sent Li Qiong to Wuwei army to back Lu and Hao.

sentences.zh: 賊乃還。

translations.literal: The bandits then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，以右文殿修撰王倫為都督府參議官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei: Right Culture Hall compiler Wang Lun was made commander-in-chief staff planning officer.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiwei: Right Culture Hall compiler Wang Lun became commander-in-chief planning officer.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔監司、帥守察內外宗子病民害政者以聞。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict ordered surveillance commissioners and commandery defenders to investigate inner and outer imperial clansmen who harmed the people or government and report.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, surveillance commissioners and defenders were told to report clansmen who harmed people or government.

sentences.zh: 崔增、吳全遇湖賊于陽武口，死之。

translations.literal: Cui Zeng and Wu Quan met lake bandits at Yangwu mouth and died.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zeng and Wu Quan met lake bandits at Yangwu mouth and were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，韓肖胄等使還。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Han Xiaozhou and the other envoys returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Han Xiaozhou and the other envoys returned.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禁沿淮諸砦兵擅侵齊境。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Huai embankment garrison troops were forbidden to raid Qi territory on their own.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Huai stockade troops were forbidden to raid Qi on their own.

sentences.zh: 庚午，臨安府火。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Lin'an superior prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Lin'an caught fire.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禁掠賣生口入蠻夷嵠峒及以銅錢出中國。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: it was forbidden to sell captives into Man, Yi, Xi, and Dong regions or to take copper cash out of China.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, selling captives into Man, Yi, Xi, and Dong and taking copper cash abroad were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復元祐十科舉士法。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Yuanyou ten-category examination-for-office law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Yuanyou ten-category examination law was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命賓、橫、宜、觀四州市戰馬。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Bin, Heng, Yi, and Guan four prefectures were ordered to purchase war horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Bin, Heng, Yi, and Guan were ordered to buy war horses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王𤫉自鼎州引兵還鄂，留統領王渥等四軍聽程昌寓節制。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Xie led his army back from Ding to E and left commanders Wang Wo and four other armies under Cheng Changyu's command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Xie withdrew from Ding to E and left Wang Wo and four commands under Cheng Changyu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，蠲南劍州所負民間獻納錢十六萬緡。

translations.literal: Day jimao: sixteen hundred thousand strings of Nanjian's owed popular presentation money were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, sixteen hundred thousand strings of Nanjian's owed presentation money were remitted.

sentences.zh: 省淮南州縣文武官。

translations.literal: Huainan prefectures and counties had civil and military posts reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan prefectures and counties cut civil and military posts.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳朔，降敕書撫諭吳玠及川、陝將士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinsi new moon: an edict-letter soothed Wu Jie and the Sichuan-Shaanxi officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinsi new moon: an edict-letter soothed Wu Jie and the Sichuan-Shaanxi troops.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，臨安府火。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Lin'an superior prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Lin'an caught fire.

sentences.zh: 戊子，又火。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: fire again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, fire struck again.

sentences.zh: 朱勝非以屢火求罷，不允。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei, because of repeated fires, begged dismissal; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei begged out over repeated fires and was refused.

sentences.zh: 丙申，王似承制廢通遠軍。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wang Si on discretionary authority abolished Tongyuan army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Wang Si on his own authority abolished Tongyuan army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，金國元帥府遣李永壽、王翊來見。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Jin commander headquarters sent Li Yongshou and Wang Yi to have audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Jin commander headquarters sent Li Yongshou and Wang Yi to audience.

sentences.zh: 是歲，海寇黎盛犯潮州，焚民居毀城去。

translations.literal: That year, sea bandit Li Sheng raided Chao prefecture, burned dwellings, and ruined the walls before leaving.
translations.idiomatic: That year sea bandit Li Sheng raided Chao, burned dwellings, and ruined the walls before leaving.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛亥朔，帝在臨安，率百官遙拜二帝。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, first month, xinhai new moon: the Emperor was at Lin'an; he led the hundred officials in bowing from afar to the two emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, first month, xinhai new moon: at Lin'an the Emperor led officials in bowing from afar to the two emperors.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，增淮、浙路鹽鈔貼納錢。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Huai and Zhe salt certificate surcharge money was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Huai and Zhe salt certificate surcharges were raised.

sentences.zh: 遣章誼等為金國通問使。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi and others were sent as Jin inquiry envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi and others were sent as Jin inquiry envoys.

sentences.zh: 己未，程昌寓遣杜湛、王渥攻楊太皮真砦，破之。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan and Wang Wo to attack Yang Yao's Pizhen stockade and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan and Wang Wo against Yang Yao's Pizhen stockade and broke it.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔諭王似、盧法原、吳玠，使之協和。

translations.literal: Day jisi: an edict admonished Wang Si, Lu Fayuan, and Wu Jie to work in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Wang Si, Lu Fayuan, and Wu Jie were admonished to work in harmony.

sentences.zh: 金人犯宕昌、臨江砦及花石峽，關師古遣統領劉戩分兵拒卻之。

translations.literal: Jin attacked Dangchang, Linjiang stockade, and Huashi gorge; Guan Shigu sent commander Liu Zhan to divide troops and repel them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin hit Dangchang, Linjiang stockade, and Huashi gorge; Guan Shigu sent Liu Zhan to divide forces and drive them off.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔諸路將帥毋以兩國通使輒弛邊備，淮南州郡津渡尤慎譏察。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict ordered route commanders not to relax frontier defense merely because the two states exchanged envoys; Huainan prefectures and ferry crossings were especially to tighten inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, commanders were told not to slack the frontier because envoys passed; Huainan ferries were especially to tighten inspection.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷州縣新置弓手。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: newly established bowmen in prefectures and counties were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, newly established county and prefectural bowmen were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲循、梅、潮、惠四州被兵家租賦。

translations.literal: Day yihai: rent and tax on Xun, Mei, Chao, and Hui households hit by troops were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, rent and tax were remitted for Xun, Mei, Chao, and Hui households hit by troops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，申敕三省、樞密院，除官並遵舊制，毋相侵紊，除拜、罷免皆明示黜陟之由。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Three Departments and Privy Council were again admonished that all appointments follow the old system without mutual encroachment; promotion and dismissal must show the reason for reward or punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Three Departments and Privy Council were told appointments must follow old lines without encroachment, and every rise or fall must state its cause.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金人犯神坌砦，沿北嶺至大散關。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Jin attacked Shenfen stockade, came along North Ridge to Dasan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Jin attacked Shenfen stockade and came along North Ridge to Dasan Pass.

sentences.zh: 臨安府火。

translations.literal: Lin'an superior prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an caught fire.

sentences.zh: 己卯，韓肖胄罷。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Han Xiaozhou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Han Xiaozhou was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，詔贓罪至死者仍籍其貲。

translations.literal: Second month, day renwu: an edict ordered that in bribery cases reaching death the goods were still registered.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renwu: bribery cases reaching death still had goods registered.

sentences.zh: 癸未，作建康府行宮。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: a traveling palace at Jiankang superior prefecture was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, a traveling palace was built at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 席益罷。

translations.literal: Xi Yi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Yi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以徐俯兼參知政事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Xu Fu was made concurrent Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xu Fu became concurrent Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁川、陝諸將招納北軍。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Sichuan-Shaanxi commanders were forbidden to recruit northern soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Sichuan-Shaanxi commanders were forbidden to recruit northern soldiers.

sentences.zh: 湖北軍賊檀成犯長陽縣，解潛遣統領胡勉捕斬之。

translations.literal: Hubei army bandit Tan Cheng raided Changyang county; Xie Qian sent commander Hu Mian to capture and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei bandit Tan Cheng raided Changyang; Xie Qian sent Hu Mian to take and behead him.

sentences.zh: 群盜田政自襄陽犯峽州。

translations.literal: Bandit chief Tian Zheng came from Xiangyang to raid Xia prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit chief Tian Zheng came from Xiangyang to raid Xia.

sentences.zh: 己丑，解潛遣統制王恪擊政，斬之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Xie Qian sent controller Wang Ke to attack Zheng and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Xie Qian sent Wang Ke against Zheng and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，金人犯兩當縣。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Jin attacked Liangdang county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Jin attacked Liangdang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔孟庾赴行在。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict ordered Meng Yu to come to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Meng Yu was ordered to court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔三衙管軍及將帥觀察使以上，舉忠勇智略可自代者一人。

translations.literal: Day jihai: an edict ordered the three palace army directors and commanders of observation commissioner rank and above each to recommend one man of loyalty, courage, wisdom, and stratagem fit to replace himself.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the three palace directors and commanders of observation rank and above were each to name one loyal, brave, wise man fit to succeed them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，金人犯仙人關。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Jin attacked Xianren Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Jin attacked Xianren Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔權以射殿為景靈宮，四時設位朝獻。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict provisionally made the archery hall the Jingling Palace, with seasonal spirit tablets set for court sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the archery hall was provisionally made the Jingling Palace, with seasonal tablets for court sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丙午，張浚入見。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Zhang Jun had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Jun was received at court.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，吳玠率楊政、吳璘、田晟、王喜諸將與兀朮戰于仙人關，大敗之。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai new moon: Wu Jie with generals Yang Zheng, Wu Lin, Tian Sheng, and Wang Xi fought Wuzhu at Xianren Pass and routed him heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinhai new moon: Wu Jie with Yang Zheng, Wu Lin, Tian Sheng, and Wang Xi met Wuzhu at Xianren Pass and broke him.

sentences.zh: 兀朮遁去。

translations.literal: Wuzhu fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu fled.

sentences.zh: 戊午，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 以趙鼎參知政事。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding was made participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding became participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，孟庾至行在，罷都督府，以其兵屬張俊。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Meng Geng reached the mobile court; the Metropolitan Commandery was abolished and its troops assigned to Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Meng Geng reached court; the Metropolitan Commandery was abolished and its men went to Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張浚以資政殿大學士罷，尋落職奉祠、福州居住。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Jun was dismissed as Zizheng Hall grand academician; he was soon stripped of office, given temple service, and sent to reside at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Jun left the Zizheng grand academician post; he was soon stripped, given a temple sinecure, and sent to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲淮南州縣民租一年。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Huainan prefectures and counties had civilian rent remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Huainan prefectures and counties had civilian rent remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 辛未，日有青赤黃氣。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the sun showed azure, crimson, and yellow vapors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the sun showed azure, crimson, and yellow vapors.

sentences.zh: 編次建炎以來詔旨，頒諸路。

translations.literal: Edicts from Jianyan onward were compiled and issued to each route.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts from Jianyan onward were compiled and sent to each route.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠲興元府、洋州被兵家稅役二年。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Xingyuan and Yang prefectures, having suffered armies, had taxes and corvée remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, war-hit Xingyuan and Yang had taxes and corvée remitted two years.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以王似為資政殿學士、川陝宣撫使，盧法原為端明殿學士，與吳玠並充副使，關師古為熙河蘭廓路安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Wang Si was made Zizheng Hall academician and Chuan-Shaan pacification commissioner; Lu Fayuan was made Duanming Hall academician and, with Wu Jie, both deputy commissioners; Guan Shigu was made Xihe Lan-Kuo pacification and control commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Wang Si became Zizheng academician and Chuan-Shaan pacification commissioner; Lu Fayuan became Duanming academician and, with Wu Jie, deputy commissioner; Guan Shigu became Xihe Lan-Kuo pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰朔，命趙開再任總領四川財賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen new moon: Zhao Kai was ordered to resume as overall intendant of Sichuan finances.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen new moon: Zhao Kai was ordered back as overall intendant of Sichuan finances.

sentences.zh: 詔諭川、陝官吏兵民，以張浚失措當示遠竄，猶嘉其所用吳玠等能禦大敵，許國一心，止從薄責。

translations.literal: An edict admonished Chuan-Shaan officials, soldiers, and people that though Zhang Jun's missteps deserved distant exile, his use of Wu Jie and others who could repel great enemies and serve the state with one heart was still praiseworthy—only a light punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Chuan-Shaan that Zhang Jun's blunders merited distant banishment, yet his use of Wu Jie and others who held great enemies and served with one heart deserved praise—only a light penalty.

sentences.zh: 仍令宣撫司講求諮訪，凡擾民咈眾之事，速厘革之。

translations.literal: It still ordered the pacification office to study and consult; anything harassing the people or defying the masses was to be quickly reformed.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification office was still to inquire and reform anything that harassed the people or defied public order.

sentences.zh: 癸未，劉子羽白州安置。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Liu Ziyu was assigned to Baizhou for residence.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liu Ziyu was assigned to reside at Baizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔明堂用皇祐典禮，兼祀天皇大帝、神州地祇以下諸神。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict said the Mingtang was to use the Huangyou ritual code, jointly sacrificing the Great Heaven Emperor, the Divine Land Spirit, and deities below.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Mingtang was ordered to follow Huangyou rites, jointly sacrificing the Great Heaven Emperor, the Divine Land Spirit, and lesser gods.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吳玠敗金兵，復鳳、秦、隴州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Wu Jie defeated Jin troops and recovered Feng, Qin, and Long prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wu Jie beat the Jin and retook Feng, Qin, and Long.

sentences.zh: 詔特旨處死情法不相當者，許大理奏審。

translations.literal: An edict said where special-order executions did not match law and sentiment, Dali might memorialize for review.
translations.idiomatic: Where special executions did not match law and feeling, Dali might memorialize for review.

sentences.zh: 蠲淮南州軍上供錢一年。

translations.literal: Huainan garrison armies' tribute money was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan garrison tribute money was remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，置孳生牧馬監于臨安府。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: a livestock-breeding horse supervisor was established at Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, a livestock-breeding horse supervisor was set at Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷廣西提舉茶鹽司。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Guangxi tea-and-salt intendant office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Guangxi tea-and-salt intendant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 關師古叛，以洮、岷二州降偽齊，吳玠並將師古軍。

translations.literal: Guan Shigu rebelled, surrendered Tao and Min to puppet Qi, and Wu Jie absorbed Shigu's army.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Shigu rebelled, handed Tao and Min to puppet Qi, and Wu Jie took over his army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諸路歲上戶口。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered each route yearly to report household registers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, each route was ordered to report household registers yearly.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷諸州回易庫。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: circuit remittance-and-exchange treasuries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, circuit remittance treasuries were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命劉光世遣兵巡邊。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Liu Guangshi was ordered to send troops to patrol the borders.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Liu Guangshi was ordered to patrol the borders.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，保靜州夷人入貢。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Baojing prefecture Yi people presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Baojing Yi presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，徐俯罷。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Xu Fu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Xu Fu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是月，王似承制廢符陽軍。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Si by delegated order abolished Fuyang army.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wang Si abolished Fuyang army by delegated order.

sentences.zh: 知壽春府羅興叛降偽齊。

translations.literal: Shouchun prefecture magistrate Luo Xing rebelled and surrendered to puppet Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Shouchun magistrate Luo Xing rebelled and went over to puppet Qi.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌朔，以岳飛兼黃復二州、漢陽軍、德安府制置使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu new moon: Yue Fei was made concurrent controller of Huang and Fu prefectures, Hanyang army, and De'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengxu new moon: Yue Fei was made controller of Huang, Fu, Hanyang army, and De'an.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以范沖為宗正少卿兼直史館，重修神宗哲宗《正史》、《實錄》。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Fan Chong was made deputy director of the Imperial Clan and concurrent History Office editorialist, to revise Shenzong and Zhezong Veritable Records and drafts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Fan Chong became Imperial Clan deputy director and History Office editorialist to revise Shenzong and Zhezong Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔淮南帥臣兼營田使，守令以下兼管營田。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: an edict made Huainan circuit military commissioners concurrently garrison-farm commissioners; prefectural magistrates and below jointly managed garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Huainan military commissioners were made garrison-farm commissioners; magistrates and below jointly ran the farms.

sentences.zh: 岳飛復郢州，斬偽齊守荊超。

translations.literal: Yue Fei recovered Ying prefecture and beheaded puppet Qi defender Jing Chao.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei retook Ying and beheaded puppet Qi defender Jing Chao.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以孟庾兼權樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Meng Geng was made concurrently acting Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Meng Geng was made acting Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜李橫軍絹萬匹。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Li Heng's army was given ten thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Li Heng's army was given ten thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李成棄襄陽去，岳飛復取之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Li Cheng abandoned Xiangyang and left; Yue Fei recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Li Cheng abandoned Xiangyang; Yue Fei retook it.

sentences.zh: 金人攻金州，鎮撫使王彥遣統制許青等與戰于漢陰，敗之。

translations.literal: Jin attacked Jin prefecture; pacification commissioner Wang Yan sent overall controller Xu Qing to fight at Hanyin and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Jin; pacification commissioner Wang Yan sent Xu Qing to fight at Hanyin and beat them back.

sentences.zh: 罷諸縣武尉。

translations.literal: County military commissioners were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: County military commissioners were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬申，裁省三省、樞密細務，責六曹長貳專決。

translations.literal: Day renshen: minor business of the Three Departments and Privy Council was trimmed; Six Bureaus chiefs were charged to decide alone.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Three Departments and Privy Council detail work was cut; Six Bureaus chiefs were to decide alone.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以國史日曆所為史館。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the National History Daily Calendar office was made the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the National History Daily Calendar office became the History Office.

sentences.zh: 偽齊收李成餘眾，益兵駐新野，岳飛與別將王萬夾擊，復大敗之。

translations.literal: Puppet Qi absorbed Li Cheng's remnant troops and reinforced at Xinye; Yue Fei and separate commander Wang Wan struck jointly and routed them again.
translations.idiomatic: Puppet Qi took Li Cheng's remnants, reinforced at Xinye; Yue Fei and Wang Wan struck together and broke them again.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王彥數敗金兵于洵陽縣。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Wang Yan repeatedly defeated Jin troops at Xunyang county.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wang Yan repeatedly beat the Jin at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，復選宗室子彥之子伯玖育于禁中。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: imperial clansman Bo Jiu, son of Prince Yan, was again selected to be raised in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Bo Jiu, son of Prince Yan, was again chosen to be raised in the palace.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，復命川、陝類試。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Chuan-Shaan categorized examinations were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renshen: Chuan-Shaan categorized examinations were restored.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太白晝見經天。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Venus appeared in daylight crossing heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Venus crossed the sky in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔神武軍、神武副軍統制、統領官並隸樞密院。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: an edict made Divine Martial army and Divine Martial deputy army overall controllers and commanders all subordinate to the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Divine Martial and Divine Martial deputy overall controllers and commanders were all placed under the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以霖雨，罷不急之役。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: because of prolonged rain, non-urgent labor was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, prolonged rain halted non-urgent labor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔三省、樞密院，凡奉幹請墨敕，許執奏不行。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict to the Three Departments and Privy Council said all dry-run memorial draft edicts might be held and not executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Three Departments and Privy Council were told draft edicts from private requests might be held and not issued.

sentences.zh: 置史館校勘官。

translations.literal: History Office collation officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: History Office collation officers were established.

sentences.zh: 作明堂行禮殿於教場。

translations.literal: The Mingtang ritual hall was built at the drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: A Mingtang ritual hall was built on the drill ground.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禁諸軍強刺平人為兵，已刺者皆釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: all armies were forbidden to forcibly tattoo civilians as soldiers; those already tattooed were all released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, armies were forbidden to press-gang civilians by tattoo; those already tattooed were released.

sentences.zh: 吳玠乞宮觀，不允。

translations.literal: Wu Jie begged for a palace-sinecure post; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie begged a palace sinecure; it was refused.

sentences.zh: 是月，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: That month, Mars trespassed on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That month Mars trespassed on the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 岳飛將牛皋復隨州，執偽齊守王嵩，磔之。

translations.literal: Yue Fei sent Niu Gao to recover Suizhou, seized puppet Qi defender Wang Song, and dismembered him.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei sent Niu Gao to retake Suizhou, seized puppet Qi defender Wang Song, and dismembered him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申朔，曲敕虔州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen new moon: a special amnesty edict to Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen new moon: a special amnesty edict went to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書胡松年簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Personnel Minister Hu Songnian was made Privy Council signatory.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel Minister Hu Songnian became Privy Council signatory.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以湖南安撫席益為安撫制置大使。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Hunan pacification commissioner Xi Yi was made grand pacification and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hunan pacification commissioner Xi Yi became grand pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 建昌軍軍卒修達等作亂，殺守臣劉滂，江西制置使胡世將遣參謀侯愨、統制丘贇討之。

translations.literal: Jianchang army soldiers Xiu Da and others rebelled and killed defender Liu Pang; Jiangxi commissioner Hu Shijiang sent staff Hou Que and commander Qiu Yun against them.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang soldiers Xiu Da and others rebelled and killed Liu Pang; Jiangxi commissioner Hu Shijiang sent Hou Que and Qiu Yun against them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命吳玠通信夏國。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wu Jie was ordered to communicate with the Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wu Jie was ordered to open contact with Xia.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，湖賊楊欽等破社木砦，官軍敗卻，小將許筌戰歿。

translations.literal: Day guichou: lake bandit Yang Qin broke Shemu stockade; government troops were driven back; junior officer Xu Quan died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, lake bandit Yang Qin took Shemu stockade; government troops were beaten back and Xu Quan fell.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賞仙人關之功，以吳玠為檢校少師、奉寧保靜軍節度使，吳璘、楊政以下論賞有差。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: rewards for Xianren Pass merit—Wu Jie was made checked Junior Mentor and Fengning-Baojing military commissioner; Wu Lin, Yang Zheng, and others were rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xianren Pass rewards made Wu Jie checked Junior Mentor and Fengning-Baojing military commissioner; Wu Lin, Yang Zheng, and others were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命左右司歲考郎官功過治狀以為賞罰。

translations.literal: Day dingji: the left and right headquarters were ordered yearly to appraise bureau officers' merit records for rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji, left and right headquarters were to appraise bureau officers yearly for reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復曲端、趙哲官。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Qu Duan and Zhao Zhe had their offices restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Qu Duan and Zhao Zhe were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，岳飛遣統制王貴、張憲擊敗李成及金兵于鄧州之西，復鄧州，禽其將高仲。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Yue Fei sent overall controllers Wang Gui and Zhang Xian to defeat Li Cheng and Jin troops west of Deng, recover Deng, and capture commander Gao Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yue Fei sent Wang Gui and Zhang Xian to beat Li Cheng and the Jin west of Deng, retake Deng, and seize Gao Zhong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，侯愨引兵入建昌軍，執修達等十三人，斬之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Hou Que led troops into Jianchang army, seized thirteen including Xiu Da, and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Hou Que entered Jianchang, seized thirteen including Xiu Da, and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 罷建州臘茶綱。

translations.literal: The Jianzhou wax-tea tribute convoy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianzhou wax-tea tribute convoy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔江東安撫司招水軍千五百人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Jiangdong pacification office to recruit fifteen hundred naval troops.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong pacification was ordered to recruit fifteen hundred naval troops.

sentences.zh: 己巳，湖賊萬餘人詣鼎、澧二州降。

translations.literal: Day jisi: lake bandits over ten thousand surrendered at Ding and Li prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, more than ten thousand lake bandits surrendered at Ding and Li.

sentences.zh: 劉光世來朝。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi came to court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，王貴、張憲破金、齊兵，復唐州及信陽軍，襄漢悉平。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Wang Gui and Zhang Xian broke Jin and Qi troops, recovered Tang prefecture and Xinyang army, and Xiang-Han was all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Gui and Zhang Xian broke Jin and Qi forces, retook Tang and Xinyang army, and Xiang-Han was cleared.

sentences.zh: 辛未，章誼、孫近使還入見，粘罕致書約淮南毋得屯兵。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: envoys Zhang Yi and Sun Jin returned to audience; Nianhan sent a letter agreeing Huainan must not station troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhang Yi and Sun Jin returned from mission; Nianhan wrote that Huainan must not hold troops.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，以趙鼎知樞密院事，充川、陝宣撫處置使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: Zhao Ding was made Privy Council affairs and Chuan-Shaan pacification disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengchen: Zhao Ding became Privy Council affairs and Chuan-Shaan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 湖賊夏誠等犯枝江縣，解潛遣將蔣定舟與戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Lake bandit Xia Cheng attacked Zhijiang county; Xie Qian sent commander Jiang Dingzhou to fight and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lake bandit Xia Cheng struck Zhijiang; Xie Qian sent Jiang Dingzhou and routed him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吳玠遣統領姚仲攻隴城縣，克之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Wu Jie sent commander Yao Zhong to attack Longcheng county and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wu Jie sent Yao Zhong against Longcheng and took it.

sentences.zh: 壬午，王𤫉以討賊無功，降光州觀察使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Wang Yuan, for failure to suppress bandits, was reduced to Guangzhou observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wang Yuan, having failed against bandits, was demoted to Guangzhou observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，改命趙鼎都督川、陝、荊、襄諸軍事。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the order was changed—Zhao Ding was made grand marshal of Chuan-Shaan, Jing, and Xiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhao Ding was made grand marshal of Chuan-Shaan, Jing, and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣魏良臣等充金國通問使。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Wei Liangchen and others were sent as Jin communication envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wei Liangchen and others were sent as envoys to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙申，毀王安石舒王告。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Wang Anshi's Prince Shu imperial notice was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Wang Anshi's Prince Shu imperial notice was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，周十隆出降，為官軍所掠，復遁去，犯汀、循州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Zhou Shilong came to surrender, was looted by government troops, fled again, and raided Ting and Xun prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhou Shilong surrendered, was looted by government troops, fled again, and raided Ting and Xun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王似罷。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Wang Si was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wang Si was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以岳飛為清遠軍節度使、湖北荊襄潭州制置使，代王𤫉討湖賊。

translations.literal: Yue Fei was made Qingyuan army military commissioner and Hubei Jing-Xiang-Tan pacification commissioner, replacing Wang Yuan to suppress lake bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei became Qingyuan military commissioner and Hubei Jing-Xiang-Tan pacification commissioner, replacing Wang Yuan against lake bandits.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以襄陽府、隨、郢、唐、鄧州、信陽軍六郡為襄陽府路。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the six prefectures and armies of Xiangyang, Sui, Ying, Tang, Deng, and Xinyang army were made the Xiangyang circuit route.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Xiangyang, Sui, Ying, Tang, Deng, and Xinyang army were formed into the Xiangyang route.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，與趙鼎定策親征，命張俊以軍援淮東，劉光世移軍建康，車駕擇日進發。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi new moon: with Zhao Ding the policy for a personal expedition was fixed; Zhang Jun was to aid Huaidong with troops; Liu Guangshi was to move his army to Jiankang; the imperial carriage was to choose a day to set out.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingzi new moon: with Zhao Ding the court fixed a personal campaign; Zhang Jun was to reinforce Huaidong, Liu Guangshi to Jiankang, and the emperor to march on a chosen day.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以孟庾為行宮留守，留統制王進一軍及神武中軍五百人隸之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Meng Geng was made mobile-palace stay-behind; overall controller Wang Jin's one army and five hundred Divine Martial middle-army troops were left under him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Meng Geng stayed behind at the mobile palace with Wang Jin's division and five hundred Divine Martial middle-army men.

sentences.zh: 百司不預軍旅之務者，聽從便避兵。

translations.literal: All offices not involved in military affairs might avoid warfare at their convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Offices outside the armies might move clear of the fighting as they saw fit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，韓世忠自鎮江率兵復如揚州。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Han Shizhong from Zhenjiang led troops again to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Han Shizhong marched again from Zhenjiang to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 金人犯滁州。

translations.literal: Jin attacked Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以張俊為浙西、江東宣撫使。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was made western Zhe and Jiangdong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun became western Zhe and Jiangdong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人圍亳州。

translations.literal: Jin besieged Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 席益遣統制吳錫率兵討徭賊楊再興，大破之。

translations.literal: Xi Yi sent overall controller Wu Xi to suppress Yao bandit Yang Zaixing and routed him heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Yi sent Wu Xi against Yao bandit Yang Zaixing and broke him.

sentences.zh: 壬午，偽齊兵犯安豐縣。

translations.literal: Day renwu: puppet Qi troops attacked Anfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, puppet Qi struck Anfeng county.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復以張浚為資政殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhang Jun was again made Zizheng Hall academician, director of Wanshou Temple, and concurrent lecture-companion.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Jun was again Zizheng academician, director of Wanshou Temple, and lecture-companion.

sentences.zh: 甲申，復以王𤫉為建武軍承宣使、江西沿江制置使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Wang Yuan was again made Jianwu army commissioner and Jiangxi river-coast pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Yuan was again Jianwu commissioner and Jiangxi river-coast pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命胡松年詣江上，會諸將議進兵。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Hu Songnian was ordered to the Yangtze to confer with generals on advancing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Hu Songnian was sent to the river to confer with generals on advance.

sentences.zh: 戊子，韓世忠邀擊金人於大儀鎮，敗之，又遣將董旼敗之於天長縣鴉口橋。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Han Shizhong intercepted Jin at Dayi town and routed them; he also sent Dong Yan to defeat them at Yekou bridge in Tianchang county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Han Shizhong intercepted the Jin at Dayi and routed them; Dong Yan beat them at Yekou bridge in Tianchang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，金人攻承州，韓世忠遣將成閔、解元合兵擊於北門，敗之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Jin attacked Cheng prefecture; Han Shizhong sent Cheng Min and Xie Yuan with combined troops to strike at the north gate and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Jin struck Cheng; Han Shizhong sent Cheng Min and Xie Yuan to hit the north gate and beat them back.

sentences.zh: 金人圍濠州。

translations.literal: Jin besieged Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣秘書正字楊晨持詔撫諭四川。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Secretariat proofreader Yang Chen was sent with an edict to comfort Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Secretariat proofreader Yang Chen was sent with an edict to comfort Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 遣侍御史魏矼、監察御史田如鼇詣劉光世、張俊軍中計事，光世始移軍太平州。

translations.literal: Palace attendant censor Wei Bang and surveillance censor Tian Ruei were sent to Liu Guangshi and Zhang Jun's armies to plan affairs; Guangshi then moved his army to Taiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Wei Bang and Tian Ruei were sent to Liu Guangshi and Zhang Jun to plan; Guangshi then moved to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命後宮自溫州泛海如泉州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the rear palace was ordered from Wenzhou by sea to Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the rear palace was ordered from Wenzhou by sea to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 金人陷濠州，守臣寇宏棄城走。

translations.literal: Jin took Haozhou; defender Kou Hong abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Haozhou; defender Kou Hong fled the city.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔州縣團教弓手、土兵。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict ordered prefectures and counties to train archer militia and local troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, prefectures and counties were ordered to train archer militia and local troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝御舟發臨安，劉錫、楊沂中以禁兵扈從。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the emperor rode a boat from Lin'an; Liu Xi and Yang Yizhong with palace guards escorted him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the emperor sailed from Lin'an; Liu Xi and Yang Yizhong escorted with palace guards.

sentences.zh: 己亥，韓世忠捷奏至，命收瘞戰死將士，仍令胡松年致祭。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Han Shizhong's victory memorial arrived; he was ordered to collect and bury battle-dead officers and soldiers; Hu Songnian was still ordered to offer sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Han Shizhong's victory report arrived; battle dead were to be gathered and buried, and Hu Songnian was to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張俊率兵發鎮江，如建康。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhang Jun led troops from Zhenjiang toward Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Jun marched from Zhenjiang toward Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，帝次平江。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the emperor stopped at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the emperor halted at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 加贈陳東、歐陽澈秘閣修撰，官其子孫二人，各賜田一頃，且追咎汪伯彥落觀文殿學士，黃潛善更不追復。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Chen Dong and Ouyang Che were posthumously raised to Secretariat draft compilers; each man's two grandsons and sons were granted one qing of fields; blame was also traced on Wang Boyan, stripping his Guanwen Hall academician rank; Huang Qianshan was given no further restoration.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Chen Dong and Ouyang Che were posthumously made Secretariat draft compilers; each had two sons or grandsons given one qing of land; Wang Boyan was blamed and stripped of Guanwen academician rank; Huang Qianshan was not restored.

sentences.zh: 命韓世忠、楊沂中分兵控扼沿海要地。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong and Yang Yizhong were ordered to divide troops and control coastal key points.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong and Yang Yizhong were to divide forces and hold coastal passes.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，焚決淮東閘堰。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Huaidong sluice dykes were burned and breached.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Huaidong sluice dykes were burned and breached.

sentences.zh: 賜扈從諸軍錢。

translations.literal: Accompanying armies were gifted money.
translations.idiomatic: Escort armies were given cash.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，仇悆遣將孫暉擊金人于壽春，敗之，復霍丘、安豐二縣。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Qiu Kui sent commander Sun Hui to strike Jin at Shouchun, routed them, and recovered Huoqiu and Anfeng counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Qiu Kui sent Sun Hui against the Jin at Shouchun, routed them, and retook Huoqiu and Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 是月，借江、浙坊場錢一界，以備軍費。

translations.literal: That month, Jiang-Zhe commutation salt coin was borrowed for one term to meet military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: That month one term of Jiang-Zhe commutation salt coin was borrowed for the armies.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wushen: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賞承州水砦首領徐康等要擊金兵之功，轉官有差，仍蠲承、楚、泰州水砦民兵賦役十年。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Chengzhou water-stockade leaders Xu Kang and others were rewarded for intercepting Jin troops, with promotions by degree; Cheng, Chu, and Tai water-stockade militia taxes and corvée were still remitted ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Xu Kang and other Cheng water-stockade leaders were rewarded for ambushing the Jin; Cheng, Chu, and Tai stockade militia had taxes and corvée remitted ten years.

sentences.zh: 置沿江烽火，放浙東諸郡防城丁夫。

translations.literal: River-coast beacon fires were set up; eastern Zhe prefectures released city-guard corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: River beacons were lit; eastern Zhe released city-guard corvée.

sentences.zh: 壬子，始下詔聲劉豫逆罪，論親討之旨，以厲六師。

translations.literal: Day renzi: an edict first proclaimed Liu Yu's rebellious crimes and the aim of a personal campaign to rouse the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, an edict first denounced Liu Yu's treason and announced the emperor's own campaign to stir the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 吳玠遣統制楊從儀等率兵敗金人於臘家城。

translations.literal: Wu Jie sent overall controller Yang Congyi and others to rout Jin at Laji city.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie sent Yang Congyi and others to rout the Jin at Laji.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，玠乞納節贖劉子羽罪，遂聽子羽自便。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Wu Jie begged to surrender his commission to redeem Liu Ziyu; Liu Ziyu was then allowed free movement.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wu Jie begged to give up his commission to redeem Liu Ziyu; Liu Ziyu was then left at liberty.

sentences.zh: 金人入光州。

translations.literal: Jin entered Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin entered Guang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，偽齊知光州許約破石額山砦，遂據之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: puppet Qi Guang prefect Xu Yue broke Shi'e Mountain stockade and then held it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, puppet Qi Guang prefect Xu Yue took Shi'e Mountain stockade and held it.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，韓世忠遣兵夜劫金人營於承州，破之。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Han Shizhong sent troops to night-raid the Jin camp at Chengzhou and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Han Shizhong night-raided the Jin camp at Chengzhou and broke it.

sentences.zh: 金人犯六合縣，丙辰，掠全椒縣三城湖。

translations.literal: Jin attacked Liuhe county; on bingchen they plundered Three Cities Lake at Quanjiao county.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin struck Liuhe; on bingchen they raided Three Cities Lake in Quanjiao.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戒諸路大小臣僚借貸催科縱吏奸擾民，及務絕盜賊之伺隙者。

translations.literal: Day dingji: all routes were warned that great and small ministers must not borrow, urge collection, or indulge clerks harassing the people, and must cut off bandits watching for openings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji, all routes were warned against lending, harsh collection, clerk abuse, and leaving openings for bandits.

sentences.zh: 命董旼、趙康直總領淮東水砦。

translations.literal: Dong Yan and Zhao Kangzhi were ordered to overall lead Huaidong water stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yan and Zhao Kangzhi were ordered to command Huaidong water stockades.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以胡松年兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Hu Songnian was made concurrently acting participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Hu Songnian became acting participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 金人陷滁州。

translations.literal: Jin took Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 劉光世移軍建康，韓世忠移軍鎮江，張俊移軍常州。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi moved his army to Jiankang, Han Shizhong to Zhenjiang, and Zhang Jun to Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi shifted to Jiankang, Han Shizhong to Zhenjiang, and Zhang Jun to Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，復命張浚知樞密院事，以其盡忠竭節詔諭中外。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhang Jun was again ordered to Privy Council affairs, with an edict praising his utmost loyalty and exhausting integrity to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhang Jun was again made Privy Council affairs, with an edict praising his full loyalty to the state.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宴犒守江將士。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: a banquet rewarded river-defense officers and troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, river defenders were feasted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，劉光世遣統制王德擊金人于滁州之桑根，敗之。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Liu Guangshi sent overall controller Wang De to strike Jin at Sanggen in Chuzhou and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Liu Guangshi sent Wang De against the Jin at Sanggen in Chuzhou and routed them.

sentences.zh: 揭黃榜招諭湖賊。

translations.literal: Yellow placards were posted to induce lake bandits to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow placards were posted to win lake bandits over.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命滁、和諸州移治保聚。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Chuzhou and He prefectures were ordered to move their seats to concentrate defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Chuzhou and He were ordered to shift their seats for defense.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，金人犯滁口。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jin attacked Chukou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Jin struck Chukou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，劉光世遣統制王師晟等率兵夜入南壽春府襲金人，敗之，執偽齊知府王靖。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Liu Guangshi sent overall controller Wang Shisheng and others to night-assault southern Shouchun against Jin troops, routed them, and seized puppet Qi prefect Wang Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liu Guangshi sent Wang Shisheng by night into southern Shouchun, routed the Jin, and seized puppet Qi prefect Wang Jing.

sentences.zh: 廣賊區稠圍韶州樂昌縣，鈐轄韓京遣兵擊斬之。

translations.literal: Guang bandit Qu Chou besieged Lechang county of Shaozhou; commander Han Jing sent troops, struck, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Guang bandit Qu Chou besieged Lechang in Shaozhou; Han Jing sent troops and killed him.

sentences.zh: 詔張浚視師江上。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhang Jun to inspect armies on the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was ordered to take command on the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥朔，魏良臣、王繪還自泗州軍前入見。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yihai new moon: Wei Liangchen and Wang Hui returned from the Sizhou front to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yihai new moon: Wei Liangchen and Wang Hui returned from Sizhou to audience.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命都督府右軍統制李貴部兵屯扼福山鎮。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the metropolitan right-army overall controller Li Gui was ordered to station troops at Fushan town.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, metropolitan right-army controller Li Gui was posted at Fushan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命中軍統制王進屯兵泰州，防拓通、泰。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: middle-army overall controller Wang Jin was ordered to garrison Taizhou and defend Tong and Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, middle-army controller Wang Jin was posted at Taizhou to cover Tong and Tai.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以樞密都承旨馬擴為江西沿江制置副使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Privy Council chief steward Ma Kuo was made Jiangxi river-coast deputy pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Privy Council chief steward Ma Kuo became Jiangxi river-coast deputy pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吳倫遣兵攻臘家城，破之。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Wu Lun sent troops to attack Laji city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wu Lun attacked Laji and took it.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，聽兩淮避兵民耕種所在閒田。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: refugees on both Huai were allowed to farm idle fields where they were.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huai refugees were allowed to farm local idle land.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金、齊兵逼廬州，仇悆嬰城固守，岳飛所遣統制徐慶、牛皋援兵適至，敗走之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Jin and Qi troops pressed Luzhou; Qiu Kui held the city firmly; relief from Yue Fei's overall controllers Xu Qing and Niu Gao just arrived and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Jin and Qi pressed Luzhou; Qiu Kui held firm; Xu Qing and Niu Gao from Yue Fei arrived in time and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 劉光世亦遣統制靳賽戰於慎縣。

translations.literal: Liu Guangshi also sent overall controller Jin Sai to fight at Shen county.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi also sent Jin Sai to fight at Shen county.

sentences.zh: 張俊遣統制張宗顏擊敗金人於六合。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun sent overall controller Zhang Zongyan to rout Jin at Liuhe.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun sent Zhang Zongyan to rout the Jin at Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 詔江、浙、荊湖十四郡各募水軍五百人，名橫江軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered fourteen prefectures of Jiang, Zhe, and Jing-Hu each to recruit five hundred naval troops named the Cross-River army.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Jiang, Zhe, and Jing-Hu prefectures were each to raise five hundred naval troops as the Cross-River army.

sentences.zh: 兩浙十郡沿江海州縣招捕巡檢土軍。

translations.literal: Ten Zhe prefectures along the river and sea counties recruited catch-patrol militia.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Zhe river and sea counties recruited catch-patrol militia.

sentences.zh: 甲午，程昌寓遣杜湛、彭筠合擊楊欽，破之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan and Peng Yun jointly against Yang Qin and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Cheng Changyu sent Du Zhan and Peng Yun against Yang Qin and broke him.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以來年正旦日食，下詔修闕政，求直言。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because of a new-year solar eclipse the next year, an edict was issued to repair deficiencies in government and seek straight speech.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, with a new-year eclipse foreseen, the court called for reform and frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金人退師。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Jin withdrew their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Jin drew off.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔葬祭浙西、江東二軍之死事者。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: an edict ordered burial sacrifices for the dead of the western Zhe and Jiangdong two armies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the dead of the western Zhe and Jiangdong armies were ordered buried and honored.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，省淮南轉運司。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Huainan transport office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Huainan transport office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 遣胡松年往常熟縣、江陰軍沿江計議軍事。

translations.literal: Hu Songnian was sent to Changshu county and Jiangyin army along the river to plan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Songnian was sent along the river to Changshu and Jiangyin to plan the campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金人去滁州。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Jin left Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Jin left Chuzhou.
